title: U.S. Tax Operations & Quality Control Virtual Assistant (Seasonal)
description:
About the Position



We are an established tax preparation business based in Fort Worth, Texas, seeking an experienced, highly organized U.S. Tax Operations & Quality Control Virtual Assistant to support our growing team during the upcoming tax season.



We are looking for someone with hands-on experience in U.S. individual tax preparation, IRS compliance, quality control, client file management, and team coordination.



This position requires someone who can work independently, identify errors, maintain organized records, and communicate directly with tax preparers to ensure all required documentation and compliance procedures are completed.



This is NOT an entry-level position. Previous U.S. tax preparation experience is required. During the busiest months hours will go to 40.



Key Responsibilities

Tax Preparation & Quality Control

Prepare and review individual U.S. federal tax returns (Form 1040).

Review Schedule C self-employment income and expenses.

Identify incorrect filing statuses, missing income, questionable deductions, and potential tax preparation errors.

Review returns completed by other tax preparers before submission.

Assist with correcting rejected returns and resolving software issues.

Work within TaxSlayer Pro.

IRS Compliance & Due Diligence

Review Form 8867 and applicable supporting documentation.

Check due diligence requirements for EITC, CTC/ACTC, AOTC, and Head of Household.

Ensure preparers properly complete and save due diligence notes.

Identify incomplete documentation, inconsistencies, and compliance concerns.

Flag questionable returns for management review.

Client File Management & Organization

Audit client files to ensure required documents are uploaded and properly organized.

Verify completion of client intake forms and applicable tax documents.

Ensure required signatures, supporting documentation, and preparer notes are saved.

Identify missing documents and follow up with preparers.

Maintain accurate records of incomplete and completed client files.

Ensure office documentation procedures are consistently followed.

Team Communication & Accountability

Communicate directly with tax preparers through designated team communication channels.

Follow up on missing client documents, incomplete files, and outstanding corrections.

Monitor preparers' compliance with office procedures.

Track outstanding tasks and deadlines.

Identify recurring errors and recommend additional training when necessary.

Escalate unresolved concerns to management.

Tax Office Operations & Reporting

Monitor the progress of returns throughout the preparation and review process.

Track pending, accepted, rejected, and incomplete returns.

Maintain organized quality-control and compliance tracking reports.

Provide daily updates on completed reviews, missing documents, and outstanding issues.

Assist management with keeping tax season operations organized and efficient.

Required Qualifications

Minimum 3 years of hands-on U.S. individual tax preparation experience preferred.

Strong understanding of Form 1040 and Schedule C.

Previous experience reviewing returns prepared by other tax professionals.

Knowledge of IRS due diligence requirements, including Form 8867.

Experience with TaxSlayer Pro strongly preferred.

Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

Strong attention to detail and ability to identify errors.

Excellent written English communication skills.

Comfortable communicating directly with a remote team.

Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines independently.

Commitment to taxpayer confidentiality and secure handling of sensitive information.

Availability during agreed U.S. Central Time working hours.



How to Apply — Please Read Carefully



To confirm that you have carefully read this entire job posting, you MUST include the word "TAXES" in the first line of your application message.



Please also include your résumé, a brief summary of your U.S. tax preparation experience, and your expected hourly rate.



IMPORTANT: Applications that do not include the word "TAXES" in the first line will not be considered or receive a response. No exceptions.



Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for the next steps in our hiring process.

title: Appointment Setter | Financial Education & Coaching | $2,000 Base + Performance Pay
description:
Overview

We’re hiring a dedicated phone appointment setter for a financial education and coaching business.



You’ll work with our sales team to turn webinar registrants, past leads, and follow-up opportunities into qualified consultations with our closer. We’re looking for someone who can build trust, ask good questions, and consistently book people who actually attend.



This is a remote, full-time opportunity for an experienced setter based in the Philippines.



What You’ll Do

• Call and follow up with assigned leads through phone, SMS, and
.

• Reengage past webinar registrants, no-shows, and older leads.

• Help upcoming registrants prepare for and attend the webinar.

• Follow up with attendees who haven’t booked, and offer the replay to people who missed it.

• Qualify prospects using the company’s criteria, understand their goals, and explain the value of a consultation.

• Book and confirm appointments, coordinate reschedules, and follow up with no-shows.

• Keep GoHighLevel updated with accurate notes, outcomes, and next steps.

• Share daily activity and results with the team through Slack.



Who You Are

• An experienced phone setter with evidence of qualified bookings and strong show rates.

• Comfortable with warm leads, older leads, and outbound calling.

• Clear, natural spoken English and strong written communication.

• Confident using GoHighLevel or a similar CRM.

• Strong at discovery, listening, handling objections, and guiding a conversation toward a clear next step.

• Organized, accountable, coachable, and consistent with follow-up.

• Able to keep conversations focused and concise.

• Reliable computer, internet connection, headset, and a quiet calling environment.

• Webinar or coaching-offer experience is a plus.



Work Environment & Support

You’ll have scripts, frameworks, SOPs, and support from leadership and the sales team. We want someone who can use that structure, own their results, and help improve the process.



Working Hours

Full time, approximately 40 hours per week. You must be available to call US-based prospects during appropriate US daytime and evening hours. The exact schedule will be agreed during the interview process.



What Success Looks Like

We’re a performance-based business. We reward efficiency, skill, and consistent results.



• The standard activity expectation is 100+ dials per day, with at least 6 qualified, setter-generated appointments booked per week.

• If you consistently book 8–10 qualified appointments per week, you can achieve that with fewer dials. Strong results earn flexibility on call volume.

• Maintain a 75%+ show rate. Appointment quality and attendance matter alongside bookings.

• Prospects understand the consultation and meet our qualification criteria before booking.

• Keep accurate CRM records, report daily, and follow through consistently.

• Reschedules, duplicate bookings, and test appointments are not counted as new production.



Compensation (USD)

• Base: $2,000 per month.

• Qualified held appointment: $45 when a qualified prospect you personally generated attends their consultation.

• Closed-client bonus: $150 when one of your appointments becomes a paying client.



Monthly Production Bonus

At a show rate of 75% or higher:

• 20+ setter-generated bookings: $500.

• 25+ bookings: $1,000.

• 30+ bookings: $1,500.

• 35+ bookings: $2,250.

• 40+ bookings: $3,000.



Only the highest achieved monthly tier is paid. Bonuses do not stack. Independently self-booked webinar calls do not count toward setter production.



Example: 40 setter-generated bookings, 30 qualified held calls, and 9 resulting paying clients would total $7,700 for the month. This is a performance illustration, not guaranteed earnings. Actual pay depends on qualified attendance and closed clients.



The initial plan includes a 90-day review of performance, lead volume, targets, and compensation.



How to Apply

Please include:

• Your resume and a brief summary of your appointment-setting experience.

• The types of offers and leads you’ve worked with, plus the CRM tools you’ve used.

• Your recent dials, bookings, and show-rate results, including the period measured and your personal contribution.

• A short Loom introduction explaining why you’re a fit for this role.

• A call recording or role-play sample you have permission to share. Please remove private prospect information.

• Your availability, US-hours coverage, and earliest start date.



Hiring Process

Application review → Short call → Setting role-play → Final interview → Offer and onboarding.



Growth & Leadership Opportunities

We’re looking for someone who takes this role seriously and wants to grow with the business. As we expand, strong performers who demonstrate consistent results, ownership, and the ability to support others can be considered for leadership opportunities.



Final Note

We value people who turn skill and effort into qualified appointments that actually happen. If you’re ready to own your results, improve your craft, and build a long-term role with growth potential, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Part-Time Revenue Manager / Pricing Analyst — Airport Car Rental (Phoenix, USA)
description:
About us

Carzi is a counter and contactless car rental company at Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport with a fleet of ~100 vehicles. We operate several brand on separate pricing engines and primarily through our own website, and major OTAs like Expedia and Priceline to travelers flying into Arizona. We're a small, data-driven team and already have several excellent remote team members in the Philippines.



The role

We're looking for a part-time revenue manager to own our forward pricing. Your daily task is to price the rolling 3-week booking window on both engines, by length of stay (2, 3, 4, and 5–9 day rentals), using competitor rates, booking pace, and seasonal demand. Beyond executing rate changes, we want someone who brings recommendations and provides insights we don’t see — someone who helps the owner make better pricing decisions, not someone waiting to be told what to do.



What you'll do



 • Daily: review the next 21 days on both pricing engines, compare against competitor rates, check booking pace, and adjust rates by length-of-stay bucket within agreed guardrails

 • Weekly: send a short report on what you changed, why, and where you believe we're leaving money on the table

 • Monthly: review how forward rates performed and refine the approach

 • Learn two different pricing systems and build a repeatable daily routine for each



Who we're looking for



 • 2+ years in hotel revenue management, OTA pricing/market analysis (Expedia, Agoda, 
), airline, or car rental yield management

 • Comfortable with pace, pickup, length-of-stay rules, and competitor rate shopping

 • Strong in Google Sheets / Excel; able to explain a recommendation clearly in writing

 • Self-directed and opinionated about pricing — you'll have authority to move rates within a band and flag anything outside it

 • Reliable daily availability (this task runs 7 days a week)



Hours and pay



 • 20 hours/week, roughly 3 hours daily.



How to apply

Please include:



 1. A short description of the revenue management work you've done and the systems you used

 2. One example of a pricing decision you made that was contrary to what your manager expected, and how it turned out

 3. Your available hours in Manila time



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid pricing exercise using real (anonymized) rate and pace data from our business.

title: SEO Manager – Full Time
description:

Get Me Links is an SEO and link-building agency that partners with digital marketing agencies, and we're building new services to grow beyond what we offer today. This is not a client SEO role: you won't run campaigns for individual clients. You'll own our off-page SEO operations and build the ones that don't exist yet, then keep them running well.   Bring the outside in: share new SEO knowledge so the whole team grows past what we already know



🧬 Who You Are

An SEO manager who lives and breathes link building.

You look at a publisher site and immediately see the spam signals, the link farm footprints, or the traffic that isn't real, and you can explain why. You're savvy on how to get links that actually help: velocity, relevance, anchor text and the right tools. You also understand the full spectrum of SEO, so you know a slow site or poor keyword targeting can undermine a great link. You don't just run a playbook, you build one: you take a new idea, test it, prove it works, and turn it into a process a team can follow. You have strong opinions on SEO and can defend them, and you have the discipline to work within agreed standards once a decision is made. You keep up with algorithm changes because you want to.



✅ Requirements

  A proven record of publisher outreach and relationship building at scale

  A sharp eye for link quality and risk: spam signals, link farms, Google spam policies, toxic links, disavow and penalty recovery

  Solid working knowledge of on-page and technical SEO (site speed, keyword targeting, site health), enough to judge site    quality and help shape new services

  Working knowledge across the wider SEO landscape: guest posts, niche edits and brand mentions, listicles, GEO, AI visibility,     Digital PR, Local SEO and backlink audits

title: Executive assistant for US real estate agent– Proactive, Clear English
description:
Read This First

This is not an entry-level job, and it is not for everyone. If you want a list of tasks and someone to tell you what to do every hour, please don't apply. We read every application closely, and we will know if you didn't read this whole post.

About the Role

I run a busy real estate business in the United States. I need a full-time Executive Assistant who will take everything off my plate that doesn't need me personally. You will work with me and my current admin, Elizabeth.

When I call and say "handle this," you handle it, start to finish, without needing to be reminded. If you notice it needs doing before I tell you.

What You Will Do

• Manage my
 inbox: sort, reply, flag what matters, and keep it under control

• Plan my day and manage my calendar

• Book travel: flights, hotels, cars, and full itineraries

• Handle personal tasks for me and my family, like restaurant reservations, appointments, and gifts

• Enter and update client and transaction data in our real estate systems, including the Buffini platform

• Track leads and closings in our spreadsheets and keep them accurate

Input new listings into the MLS and fill in contract details from the information I give you, for my final review

Prepare showing packets and any other materials I need for buyers and sellers throughout the day

• Follow written checklists exactly, and turn my screen recordings of tasks into new step-by-step checklists so nothing lives only in my head

• Think ahead: spot problems, deadlines, and loose ends before they become my problem

• Find, vet, and hire freelancers for specialized work, starting with 1 to 2 skilled video editors for my real estate videos

• Manage those freelancers day to day: give them direction, keep deadlines, and send finished work to me for final review

Who You Are

• Proactive. You don't wait to be told. You see what needs doing and do it.

• A fast learner. You can pick up new software quickly with little hand-holding.

• Excellent written and spoken English. Your speech must be clear and easy for American clients to understand on the phone, because you will call and
 clients, vendors, and restaurants on my behalf.

• Organized and detail-focused. Small mistakes in real estate cost real money.

• Reliable. When you say it's done, it's done.

• Comfortable with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets, Docs), or able to learn it quickly

• Real estate or executive assistant experience is a strong plus

Schedule and Pay

• Monday through Saturday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time

• This means overnight hours in the Philippines. These hours are not flexible. Only apply if you can reliably work this schedule every week.

• Some flexibility for urgent after-hours requests is a big plus, but not required

• Pay: $7 USD per hour

• Long-term, full-time position for the right person

How to Apply

Follow these instructions exactly. Applications that don't follow them will be deleted without being read.

1. Start your application with the words "Ready to handle it" as the first line.

2. In 3 to 5 sentences, tell me about a time you solved a problem for your boss before they knew it existed.

3. Record a short video (2 minutes or less) introducing yourself in English, and include the link. Speak naturally and look at the camera. Do not read from a script or a screen. Scripted videos will be rejected.

4. List the software and tools you have used, and rate your skill with Google Workspace from 1 to 10.

5. Confirm that you can work Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 5 PM US Central Time.

How We Work

We use the 1:3:1 rule. When you bring me a problem, you bring 1 clearly stated problem, 3 possible solutions, and 1 recommendation. Your job is to give me back my time, not to hand me more decisions.

My best hours belong to attracting and working with clients. Anything else that pulls me away from that is your territory. You will always be looking for ways to make my day, and my business, run smoother. When you notice me getting bogged down in tasks I shouldn't be doing, you tell me, and you come with a fix, using the 1:3:1 rule. I would rather hear "you shouldn't be doing this, let me take it" than watch you wait to be asked.

Hiring Process

1. Applications are screened. Anyone who did not follow the instructions above is removed.

2. Finalists join a live, unscripted video interview with me. Then they complete a short paid test task, such as planning a sample business trip with flights, a hotel, and a dinner reservation.

3. The best candidate starts a paid 2-week trial. If it's a good fit for both of us, the role becomes long-term.

If you made it this far and you're excited instead of nervous, you might be exactly who I'm looking for.

title: Experienced Real Estate Acquisition Manager / Deal Closer
description:
About the Company



  We are a U.S.-based real estate investment company specializing in real estate wholesaling and fix-and-flip opportunities. We are looking for an experienced Real Estate Acquisition Manager to join our team.



  This is a results-driven position for someone who understands the U.S. real estate investment market, has strong negotiation skills, and can independently evaluate properties to identify profitable investment opportunities.



  Our acquisition department consists of two primary roles. The Acquisition Specialist / Lead Manager is responsible for qualifying and nurturing seller leads. The Acquisition Manager takes over qualified opportunities, handles negotiations, underwrites potential deals, identifies investment opportunities through the MLS, and secures purchase contracts.

We are not looking for an appointment setter or entry-level real estate assistant. We need an experienced acquisition professional who knows how to analyze, negotiate, and close investment property transactions.



Primary Responsibilities



1. Seller Negotiations & Deal Closing

    *Take over qualified seller leads from the Lead Manager.

    *Communicate directly with property owners and negotiate purchase prices.

    *Build rapport and establish trust with potential sellers.

    *Identify seller motivation and determine opportunities to negotiate favorable purchase terms.

    *Handle seller objections, particularly when sellers are asking retail market value.

    *Develop negotiation strategies to bring sellers closer to investor-friendly pricing.

    *Present offers and negotiate purchase agreement terms.

    *Consistently follow up with sellers to move opportunities toward a signed contract.

    *Secure signed purchase and sale agreements that meet company investment criteria.

    *Work to convert qualified opportunities into profitable acquisitions.



2. Real Estate Underwriting & Deal Analysis



  *Analyze investment properties to determine acquisition potential.

  *Research comparable sales (comps) to establish accurate After Repair Value (ARV).

  *Evaluate property condition and estimate renovation and repair costs.

  *Calculate Maximum Allowable Offer (MAO).

  *Determine potential wholesale assignment fees and fix-and-flip profit margins.

  *Account for acquisition costs, closing costs, holding costs, and other expenses.

  *Identify potential risks that could affect the profitability of a transaction.

  *Determine whether a property meets the company's acquisition criteria.

  *Provide clear recommendations on whether to pursue, negotiate, or pass on a deal.



3. MLS Deal Sourcing & Property Filtering



  The Acquisition Manager will also be responsible for actively identifying potential investment opportunities through the  Multiple Listing Service (MLS).



  *Search MLS listings to identify potential wholesale and fix-and-flip opportunities.

  *Filter properties based on company investment criteria.

  *Identify distressed properties, undervalued listings, price reductions, and properties with extended days on market.

  *Analyze listing prices against comparable sales and estimated renovation costs.

  *Identify properties where sellers may be willing to negotiate below market value.

  *Monitor new listings and price changes to identify acquisition opportunities.

  *Contact listing agents and coordinate offers through the company's authorized real estate professionals.

  *Maintain a pipeline of potential MLS acquisitions.

  *Prioritize properties based on potential profitability and likelihood of securing favorable purchase terms.



4. Contract & Transaction Management



  *Prepare and submit purchase offers.

  *Negotiate contract terms and contingencies.

  *Coordinate with sellers, agents, title companies, and internal team members.

  *Ensure purchase agreements are completed accurately.

  *Monitor contract deadlines and important transaction milestones.

  *Maintain communication throughout the closing process.

  *Help resolve issues that could prevent transactions from closing.



5. CRM & Pipeline Management



  *Maintain accurate records of seller negotiations and acquisition opportunities.

  *Document offers, counteroffers, and seller objections.

  *Track all active negotiations and pending contracts.

  *Update CRM records and transaction statuses.

  *Provide regular updates on acquisition activity and deal progress.

  *Maintain an organized pipeline of potential acquisitions from both seller leads and MLS opportunities.



Required Qualifications & Experience



-Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in U.S. real estate wholesaling, acquisitions, or investment property transactions.

-Proven experience negotiating directly with U.S. property sellers.

-Demonstrated ability to get investment properties under contract.

-Strong understanding of real estate underwriting and investment analysis.

-Ability to independently calculate ARV, MAO, repair estimates, and potential profit margins.

-Experience analyzing comparable sales and evaluating property values.

-Experience sourcing and analyzing investment opportunities through the MLS.

-Strong understanding of wholesale transactions and fix-and-flip investments.

-Excellent spoken and written English.

-Strong negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills.

-Ability to work independently and make sound acquisition decisions.

-Comfortable working U.S. business hours.



Preferred Qualifications



**Experience working directly with U.S.-based real estate investors.

**Experience with real estate CRMs.

**Understanding of assignment contracts, double closings, and transactional coordination.

**A documented history of personally negotiating and closing wholesale deals.



Performance Expectations & KPIs



The Acquisition Manager will be evaluated based on:

Number of purchase offers submitted.

Number of properties successfully placed under contract.

Profitability of acquired properties.

Accuracy of underwriting and repair estimates.

Ability to negotiate below-market purchase prices.

Contract-to-close conversion rate.

Number of viable opportunities identified through MLS.

Consistency in managing negotiations and following up with sellers.

Overall contribution to the company's acquisition pipeline.



Compensation



+Competitive base salary based on experience.

+5% of the net assignment fee or net acquisition profit on each successfully closed deal.

+Additional monthly bonus based on deals closed per month

+Compensation will be discussed during the interview process based on experience and proven results.



Application Requirements



Applicants must submit a resume and answer the following questions:



1. How many years of experience do you have in U.S. real estate wholesaling or acquisitions?

2. How many real estate deals have you personally negotiated and gotten under contract?

3. How many of those deals successfully closed?

4. What is your experience negotiating with sellers who are asking retail market value?

5. Explain how you calculate ARV and MAO.

6. How do you estimate renovation costs when evaluating an investment property?

7. What experience do you have sourcing investment opportunities through the MLS?

8. What real estate software, CRMs, and property research platforms have you used?

9. Describe the largest or most profitable deal you have personally acquired.

10. Are you comfortable working U.S. business hours?



Interview Process: Qualified applicants may be required to complete a practical real estate underwriting assessment and a live seller negotiation role-play.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the acquisition process, think like a real estate investor, negotiate confidently, and consistently identify and secure profitable deals.

title: Senior Medical & Dental Billing, Coding & Denial Resolution Specialist
description:
# Senior Medical & Dental Billing, Coding & Denial Resolution Specialist



**Minimum 7 Years of Experience Required | Full-Cycle Billing | Denial Management | Revenue Recovery**



## About Clarity Works AI



Clarity Works AI helps medical and dental practices recover outstanding revenue, reduce denials, improve collections, and maintain consistent cash flow.



We manage billing operations for multiple practices, handling everything from claim creation and submission to complex denial resolution and revenue recovery.



## Application Requirements



Please include the following with your application:



1. Your years of medical billing experience and dental billing experience, separately.

2. The specialties, procedures, and insurance payers you've worked with.

3. The EHR systems, billing platforms, and clearinghouses you've used.

4. Your experience independently managing multiple client accounts.



Qualified candidates will be required to complete a practical billing and denial resolution assessment before receiving an offer.



## About the Role



We're looking for a highly experienced Medical & Dental Billing Specialist with at least **7 years of hands-on experience in full-cycle billing, coding, denial management, and accounts receivable recovery.**



**We are not looking for someone who only knows how to submit claims.** We need someone who understands the entire revenue cycle and has the experience to resolve difficult billing problems, recover unpaid claims, and independently manage client accounts.



The right candidate can build and submit claims from provider documentation, investigate complex denials, interpret payer responses, prepare appeals, challenge incorrect payment decisions, and follow claims through to resolution.



You should also know how to identify problems affecting an account's financial performance. If collections are declining, claims aren't being submitted, or payments are taking too long, we expect you to recognize the issue, investigate it, and take action without waiting for management to intervene.



This position requires someone who is technically strong, organized, resourceful, and accountable for results.



## Key Responsibilities



### Full-Cycle Medical & Dental Billing and Coding



- Independently manage billing for assigned medical and dental practices.

- Review clinical documentation and create accurate claims from scratch.

- Apply appropriate ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, CDT codes, and modifiers, as applicable.

- Review documentation to ensure billed services are supported and appropriate reimbursement opportunities are captured.

- Submit clean claims promptly and monitor acceptance.

- Identify missing charges, unbilled visits, incomplete documentation, and claims approaching timely filing deadlines.

- Handle insurance verification, claim corrections, payment posting, and reimbursement reconciliation.

- Review EOBs and ERAs to identify incorrect payments, adjustments, and discrepancies.

- Work with providers to obtain missing documentation, including clinical notes, narratives, X-rays, and other supporting records.



### Denial Management, Appeals & Revenue Recovery



**This is a major part of the position. We need someone with extensive, hands-on experience working denials and recovering unpaid claims.**



- Independently investigate and resolve medical and dental claim denials.

- Understand and interpret denial codes, CARC/RARC codes, EOBs, ERAs, and payer explanations.

- Determine the actual cause of a denial rather than simply correcting and resubmitting claims.

- Prepare and submit corrected claims, reconsiderations, and formal appeals with appropriate supporting documentation.

- Resolve denials involving medical necessity, authorization, eligibility, coordination of benefits, coding, modifiers, bundling, timely filing, and payer processing errors.

- Challenge incorrect payer decisions using payer policies, contract terms, clinical documentation, and applicable billing guidelines.

- Investigate underpayments and identify opportunities to recover additional reimbursement when supported by documentation and contractual terms.

- Follow up with payers, obtain reference numbers, escalate unresolved issues, and track claims until a final resolution is reached.

- Work complex and aged A/R, including claims over 90 and 120 days.

- Identify recurring denial patterns, determine their root causes, and recommend corrections to prevent future denials.

- Recognize when a claim should be corrected, appealed, escalated, or appropriately written off.



**We expect you to know how to get difficult claims paid, not simply document that they were denied.**



### Client Account Ownership & Performance



- Take responsibility for the overall billing health of assigned client accounts.

- Monitor daily claim submissions, rejections, denials, unpaid claims, and collections.

- Actively investigate claims that remain unpaid beyond 14 days, including claims already accepted by the payer.

- Identify unexpected declines in submissions, charges, payments, or collections.

- Review unbilled services regularly to ensure revenue isn't being missed.

- Prioritize work based on financial impact, timely filing deadlines, and account needs.

- Maintain accurate tracking of outstanding claims, follow-up dates, payer responses, and unresolved issues.

- Provide management with clear updates on account performance, problems identified, actions taken, and expected next steps.

- Identify workflow problems and recommend solutions to improve reimbursement and reduce recurring issues.



### Problem-Solving, Accountability & Follow-Through



- Independently investigate problems using EHR systems, clearinghouses, payer portals, provider manuals, and other available resources.

- Take initiative to resolve issues rather than waiting for detailed instructions.

- Follow through on outstanding claims and tasks until they are resolved or a documented final determination is reached.

- Escalate issues appropriately, explaining what has already been investigated and what action is needed.

- Communicate directly with insurance companies, providers, and office staff to resolve billing obstacles.

- Identify and address recurring problems rather than repeatedly handling the same issue.

- Keep leadership informed of issues that could affect submissions, collections, or timely filing.

- Take responsibility for assigned accounts and the quality of work performed.



## Required Qualifications



**Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:**



- Minimum 7 years of professional, hands-on medical and/or dental billing experience.

- Extensive experience in full-cycle billing, from claim creation through payment posting and reconciliation.

- Strong knowledge of medical and/or dental coding, including the ability to review documentation and create claims independently.

- **Proven experience independently resolving complex claim denials, preparing appeals, and recovering unpaid revenue.**

- Strong experience working aged A/R and following up directly with insurance companies.

- Ability to interpret EOBs, ERAs, payer denial codes, and reimbursement guidelines.

- Experience identifying denial patterns and addressing underlying billing problems.

- Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple client accounts.

- Strong understanding of payer requirements, timely filing, authorizations, eligibility, coordination of benefits, and reimbursement rules.

- Proficiency with EHR/EMR systems, practice management software, clearinghouses, and payer portals.

- Strong organizational skills, independent problem-solving ability, and consistent follow-through.

- Ability to communicate clearly with providers, payers, clients, and management.



**Preferred:** Substantial experience in both medical and dental billing, experience with multiple specialties, and prior employment with a revenue cycle management company.



## What Makes Someone Successful in This Role



We're looking for someone who:



- **Knows billing and denials.** You can create claims, identify coding issues, investigate denials, prepare appeals, and recover payments without needing someone to walk you through the process.

- **Takes ownership.** You know the status of your assigned accounts and don't wait for someone else to identify problems.

- **Finds solutions.** When a claim isn't paying, you investigate why, determine the next steps, and keep working toward resolution.

- **Follows through.** You don't consider a claim handled simply because you called the payer or left a note.

- **Recognizes patterns.** You notice recurring denials, submission gaps, and payment delays and work to correct the underlying cause.

- **Works independently.** You know how to research payer requirements, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple accounts without constant supervision.

- **Focuses on results.** You understand that the goal isn't just to process claims. It's to help practices collect the money they're entitled to receive.



## Performance Expectations



Performance will be evaluated based on:



- Timely and accurate submission of billable claims.

- Claim acceptance and rejection rates.

- Denial resolution and successful appeals.

- Recovery of outstanding and underpaid claims.

- Consistent follow-up on claims unpaid beyond 14 days.

- Reduction in aged accounts receivable.

- Identification and prevention of recurring billing issues.

- Overall billing health of assigned accounts.

- Communication, organization, and follow-through.



## Who Should Not Apply



This position is not suitable for candidates who:



- Have fewer than 7 years of hands-on billing experience.

- Only have experience submitting claims prepared by others.

- Have limited experience investigating denials or preparing appeals.

- Routinely forward difficult claims to supervisors instead of investigating them.

- Only work claims from assigned task lists without monitoring the overall account.

- Require frequent reminders to follow up on unpaid claims.

- Consider a claim complete after a single payer call or resubmission.

- Are uncomfortable independently managing multiple accounts.

We're looking for a highly experienced Virtual Assistant who has already worked in sales and customer-facing roles with US clients. You'll be responsible for:

You'll be the first voice these homeowners hear, so you need proven experience making customers comfortable, earning their trust quickly, and moving them toward booking. Speed matters most during our busy season (September–December).

2. Commercial Outreach. Research businesses and properties in our service area that would benefit from permanent lighting, using Google Maps, Google Search and listing sites. Targets include restaurants, retail centers, apartment communities, HOAs, churches, property managers and home builders. Log leads in our CRM and send personalized cold
s and follow-ups to book on-site consultations. The target is 25–40 outreaches per day, and every one must be personalized.

Each morning, message the previous day's install customers to make sure they're happy with their lighting and comfortable using the app, so any issues get caught early. 4. Upsells & Past-Customer Sales. Follow up with past customers, using their job history in the CRM, to offer add-ons. Examples include extending lighting to other areas of the home (garage, back of house, second story, landscape) and seasonal promotions. Identify interested buyers and hand them off to the owner to close.

5. Booking Appointments

6. Customer Service



You'll also send a daily report at the end of each shift and post content to our social media accounts.

Hours: Full-time, Monday–Friday, aligned to US Eastern business hours.

title: Influencer Outreach Coordinator | The Morning Hero

## What you’ll do

title: ACCOUNTANT AND FINANCE OPERATIONS SPECIALIST
description:
Remote | Part Time | 20 Hours per Week

Starting Compensation: $500 USD per Month

Negotiable Based on Experience



IMPORTANT: A video application recorded specifically for this position is required. Applications without one will not be reviewed.



You must meet all requirements.



Please overview how to apply.



If you apply and details are missed, we will assume that you are not detail oriented and will have trouble keeping track of our numbers.







ABOUT HEAVEN BOUND



Heaven Bound Music Marketing helps Christian artists and organizations grow their audiences through intentional marketing, advertising, and artist development.



We are looking for an experienced accountant who can take ownership of our financial records, understand how money moves through the business, and communicate clearly with leadership.



This position goes beyond categorizing transactions. We need someone who reconciles accounts thoroughly, catches discrepancies, maintains accurate tracking systems, and turns financial information into useful cash flow projections.



An interest in Christian music and enthusiasm for our mission are a plus.





YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



1. QUICKBOOKS AND ACCOUNT RECONCILIATION



Accurately categorize transactions and reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and payment platforms.



Investigate unmatched transactions, missing payments, duplicates, processing fees, and balance differences until they are resolved or clearly documented.



Keep supporting documentation organized and maintain a clear record of corrections.





2. FINANCIAL TRACKERS AND INVOICE TRACKING



Maintain our Google Sheets and Excel financial systems alongside QuickBooks.



Match invoices to actual payments and verify amounts received. Accurately track service fees, advertising funds, expenses, deposits, refunds, credits, and owner distributions.



Ensure records agree across systems and that outstanding invoices and unpaid obligations remain visible.





3. PAYROLL AND COMMISSION VERIFICATION



Review employee and contractor payout records and monitor our sales commission tracker.



Verify commissions against approved terms and collected payments. Check that allocation percentages total 100% and flag discrepancies before payouts are finalized.





4. CASH FLOW AND FINANCIAL PROJECTIONS



Maintain a practical cash flow forecast covering expected collections, payroll, recurring expenses, upcoming bills, and debt obligations.



Help leadership understand available cash, upcoming shortfalls, and revenue needed to cover commitments.



Clearly distinguish confirmed figures from estimates and assumptions.





5. TAX PREPARATION SUPPORT



Keep records organized for our tax professional, maintain supporting documentation, and assist with routine tax related information requests.



Recognize when an issue needs to be escalated to a qualified tax professional.





HOW WE EXPECT YOU TO WORK



ACCURACY WITH VERIFICATION



Check your work before marking it complete. Reconciliation means investigating differences, not adjusting numbers simply to make balances match.



CONSISTENT COMMUNICATION



Provide a brief written update on each scheduled workday covering completed work, unresolved questions, and anything requiring attention.



Respond to team messages within one business day and flag urgent cash or payment issues promptly during working hours.



PROACTIVE IMPROVEMENTS



Help us improve controls, simplify tracking, prevent repeated mistakes, and make financial reporting more useful.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS



- More than five years of relevant accounting or bookkeeping experience supporting online businesses.



- Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online, transaction categorization, and account reconciliation.



- Strong Google Sheets and Excel skills, including formulas, lookups, conditional calculations, and troubleshooting discrepancies.



- Experience reconciling payment processors such as Stripe, PayPal, and Wise, including fees, credits, refunds, and transfers.



- Experience preparing cash flow forecasts and explaining financial results clearly.



- Basic knowledge of United States business taxes and experience supporting an external tax professional.



- Strong written communication, attention to detail, confidentiality, and reliable follow through.



- Experience with marketing agencies, digital agencies, or other service businesses is strongly preferred.



- QuickBooks certification is a plus.



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION



This role requires 20 hours per week.



At least 12 of those hours must be worked between 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. Central Time, Monday through Friday.



The remaining hours may be flexible by agreement. We need a consistent schedule with dependable overlap for questions, collaboration, and financial deadlines.



Starting compensation is $500 USD per month. We are willing to negotiate for a candidate whose experience and demonstrated abilities closely match the role (We would be willing to go a lot higher if you can prove your worth.)

title: GoHighLevel Lead Follow-Up Specialist / Virtual Assistant – US Dog Training Business (Full Time, US Central hours)
description:
I run a dog training and boarding business in Texas. Leads come in every day through GoHighLevel from ads, Google, and our website. The automation sends the first text and
 and offers them a calendar. After that, I need a human. That’s you.



THE JOB



Every lead gets followed up until they book or say no. You work the GoHighLevel pipeline all day: reply to texts and
s inside the hour, call the ones who don’t reply, move them through the stages, book consultations onto my calendar, and keep the pipeline clean so I can see at a glance who’s hot, who’s waiting, and who’s gone cold.



You own the calendar. Consultations, drop-offs, pickups, go-home lessons. You confirm appointments the day before, you chase no-shows, and you reschedule without me being involved.



You run the follow-up sequences. The 3-day, 7-day and 30-day follow-ups for leads that didn’t book, the review requests after a dog goes home, the reminders. If a sequence isn’t firing, you notice before I do.



You answer client texts and
s during the day: updates, questions, paperwork, payment reminders. Friendly, quick, in good English, in my voice, which I’ll teach you.



You report to me once a day in three lines: leads in, consultations booked, anything stuck.



THE HOURS



US Central time, 8 am to 5 pm Monday through Friday, plus Saturday mornings 8 to noon, because Saturday is our busiest day. That’s late night to early morning in Manila. If that doesn’t work for your life, don’t apply. This isn’t a flexible-hours job, it’s a be-there-when-the-lead-texts job.



Time tracked with Time Doctor. 44 hours a week.



WHAT I NEED



You know GoHighLevel. Not “I’ve heard of it.” You’ve worked pipelines, conversations, calendars or workflows in it.



You will pick up the phone. A lot of VAs won’t call. Half of this job is calling a lead back who didn’t answer the text. Your spoken English has to be clear and confident enough to talk to a Texas family about their dog.



You follow up until it’s dead. The money in this business is in the second, third and fifth touch. If you send one message and move on, this isn’t for you.



You’re on time, every shift, with reliable internet and a quiet place to make calls.



Dog knowledge is not required. I’ll teach you what you need. Caring about doing the follow-up properly is required.



WHAT YOU GET



Full time, long term, paid every two weeks, on time. Start this week. A 90-day review with a raise if you’ve earned it. 13th month. Paid holidays after six months. A boss who answers your questions fast and tells you exactly where you stand.



HOW TO APPLY



Put the words FIFTH TOUCH at the top of your application so I know you read this. Then send me three things:



A voice recording, under 60 seconds, calling back a lead named Sarah. She asked about training for her 1-year-old Labrador that jumps on guests, and she didn’t answer our text. Just talk to her the way you’d actually talk to her.

One short paragraph on what you’ve done in GoHighLevel: pipelines, conversations, calendar, workflows, whichever you’ve actually worked, and roughly how many leads a day you handled.

What time is it in your city when it’s 8 am in Texas, and can you work that shift every weekday plus Saturday morning? Yes or no.



Applications without all three will not get a reply. Applications with all three get a reply within 48 hours, and I’m interviewing this week.

title: Listing Coordinator (Property Onboarding) $2k-$3kUSD to+ 13th Month | Full-Time Salaried | Night Shift (Hawaii Hours)
description:
Hawaii Coastal Property Management (HiCoastal) is a full-service property management brokerage in Honolulu, Hawaii, managing long-term rentals, short-term/vacation rentals, mid-term rentals, community associations, and commercial properties across the island of Oahu. We are led by a former U.S. Naval Officer and run a disciplined, systems-driven, AI-first operation: we expect our team to use modern tools (including AI assistants) to work faster and smarter than the competition.



We are hiring ONE exceptional person for a long-term, exclusive, salaried role. This is not project work and not freelancing. If hired, HiCoastal is your only client.



The Role



You will own the pipeline that takes a new rental property from "owner just signed with us" to "live, listed, and rent-ready." Every new homeowner who joins HiCoastal hands us a property that needs a sequence of things done before it can be listed: inspections, cleaning, repairs, photography, utility transfers, key/smart-lock setup, listing content, and more. Your job is to make sure every one of those steps happens, in the right order, on time, with nothing dropped.



Concretely, you will:



- Serve as the coordination hub for every new property onboarding from signed agreement to live listing

- Follow up relentlessly with homeowners to collect documents, approvals, access details, and decisions — you are the person who never lets a task go stale

- Schedule and sequence vendors and our local Hawaii team members (inspectors, cleaners, handymen, photographers) so work happens in the correct order — you cannot photograph a unit before it's cleaned, and you cannot clean it before repairs are done

- Manage and deconflict calendars across multiple team members and properties simultaneously

- Track every active onboarding in our systems and surface blockers before they become delays

- Communicate proactively: owners, teammates, and vendors should never have to ask "what's the status?"

- Reason about the big picture: when one appointment slips, you understand the downstream impact and re-sequence the whole chain without being told

- Be willing to learn and become an expert on LeadSimple, bonus points if experienced with this software system.



You are NOT a general virtual assistant. This is a specialist role with a single mission: properties get to market fast, and nothing falls through the cracks.



Who We're Looking For



Must-haves:



- 3+ years in a coordination-heavy remote role (real estate transaction/listing coordination, property management, project coordination, executive assistance with heavy scheduling, or similar)

- Demonstrated mastery of calendar and scheduling logistics across multiple people and time zones

- Excellent written AND spoken English — you will be on the phone and on video with American homeowners and our Hawaii team

- A driven, self-starting operator. We will give you the mission and the tools; we will not micromanage your task list. If you need daily direction, this is not your role

- Strong logical reasoning — you can hold a multi-step dependency chain in your head and re-plan when reality changes

- Meticulous follow-up habits. You track your own open loops without being reminded

- Comfortable adopting new software quickly, including AI tools (we will train you on our stack)



Nice-to-haves:



- Experience with property management software (AppFolio, LeadSimple, Hostaway, Buildium, or similar)

- U.S. real estate experience (listings, rentals, or transactions)

- Experience working Hawaii or U.S. West Coast hours



Schedule — Read Carefully



This is a NIGHT SHIFT role on Philippine time. You will work full Hawaii business hours:



- 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Hawaii Standard Time, Monday–Friday

description:

s and website contact-form messages: order status, sizing, delivery times, returns and exchanges.

D

 of the morning. Pressure doesn't rattle you.

US business hours, or

Central European (CET) business hours

Where this leads

We are building a customer support team and we promote from within. The person who runs the inbox well, works closely with their manager and supports their teammates will become our Head of Customer Support – training new agents, owning our support playbook and helping shape our refund and service policies. Subject line must be exactly: CALM INBOX – [Your First Name]

Writing test: reply to the customer
 below, first in English, then in Dutch or Danish (tools allowed). Keep each reply under 120 words.

"Hi, I ordered a dress three weeks ago for a wedding this Saturday and it still hasn't arrived. The tracking hasn't changed in six days. I want my money back now. – Sanne"

Applications without the subject line or the writing test will not be reviewed.

title: Phone Sales Rep (GoHighLevel): Sell Marketing Services to US Home Service Businesses, Part Time Growing to Full Time
description:
We sell a monthly marketing service to local home service businesses in the US (tree service, HVAC, septic, chimney, pest control, garage doors, and similar trades). The service is built on GoHighLevel and helps owners stop losing jobs: a text goes back automatically when they miss a call, reviews get requested after every job, past customers get reactivated, and their website converts visitors into calls. It's $297 a month with no contract.



Each business already has a free listing on our online directory. You call to confirm the listing, book a 10 minute walkthrough, and on that walkthrough sell the service.



This is a phone sales role. Booking the walkthrough is step one. Closing on the walkthrough is the job. You will follow a detailed script and work entirely inside GoHighLevel. If you have never been inside GoHighLevel, please do not apply.



SCHEDULE (2 days a week to start, 16 hours)

You start on Tuesday and Thursday. Wednesday is added when call volume supports it, and more days after that. Our goal is to grow this role into full time. You must keep Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday open so we can add a day without a conflict. You will always get at least a week's notice before any schedule change.



Each shift is 10:00 am to 6:30 pm US Eastern Time:

- 10:00 am to 12:00 pm: calling

- 12:00 to 12:15 pm: break (paid)

- 12:15 to 2:00 pm: calling

- 2:00 to 2:30 pm: lunch (unpaid)

- 2:30 to 5:00 pm: calling

- 5:00 to 5:15 pm: break (paid)

- 5:15 to 6:30 pm: calling



In the Philippines this is a night shift: about 11:00 pm to 7:30 am Manila time from November to March, and one hour earlier from March to November.



PAY

$6 an hour base plus commission. Paid weekly. The first week is a paid trial at the full rate.

- $40 for every business that signs up for the $297 per month service

- $25 for every $349 per year Top Spot listing sold

- $15 for every $149 per year Premium listing sold

Starting at 16 hours a week, moving up to full-time as the business grows. Good closers earn more.



WHAT YOU WILL SELL

- Missed call text back: when the owner can't pick up, the caller gets a text within seconds so the job isn't lost.

- Review generation: automatic review requests after every job.

- Customer reactivation: texts to past customers to bring back repeat work.

- A lead-converting website with click-to-call and quote forms.

- Included free: the top spot in their trade and town on our directory.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Call business owners from a GoHighLevel smart list using the browser dialer, starting with their free directory listing.

- Confirm each business's phone, service area, website, and owner name, and update the contact as you talk.

- Offer to verify their listing, and read a text consent question word for word before anything is texted.

- Book 10-minute walkthrough calls on a GoHighLevel calendar.

- Run the walkthroughs: text the owner their report, go through their reviews, Google profile, website, and a missed call calculator with their own numbers, then offer the $297 service and, if they're not ready, a paid directory listing.

- Stay on the line while the owner pays through a link you text them. You never take card numbers.

- Call businesses to pass along quote requests from homeowners who found them on the directory.

- Handle objections calmly using our script, and set callbacks and follow-ups.

- Log every call: notes, tags, custom fields, pipeline stages, tasks, and calendar bookings in GoHighLevel.

- Follow US calling rules: calling hours, call recording notice, do not call requests, and text consent.



REQUIRED

- At least 1 year of outbound cold calling for US clients, including closing sales over the phone, not only booking appointments.

- At least 6 months of hands-on GoHighLevel experience. You should already know how to call from the dialer, work from smart lists, update custom fields and tags, move opportunities between pipeline stages, book appointments on calendars, create tasks, add notes, and insert text snippets in Conversations.

- Clear, natural English that US business owners understand easily. Neutral accent preferred.

- Able to follow a script word for word where required, and sound friendly and natural doing it.

- Computer with Google Chrome, a USB or Bluetooth headset with a mic, a quiet room, and stable internet (plus a backup).

- Available every Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday for the full schedule above.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience selling to contractors or home service businesses.

- Experience selling software, marketing, or any monthly subscription over the phone.



HOW WE WORK

- You get a complete written script, the walkthrough flow, and a short readiness quiz before your first call.

- This is a friendly, low-pressure sale. Your job is to leave every call with the listing confirmed and a reason to follow up, and to close the ones who are ready.

- Your calls are recorded and reviewed so we can help you close more.

- Paid trial week first, at the full rate. If it's a good fit, this is a long-term role.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that skip any of these steps will not be reviewed.



1. Start your message with the word HOMEPRO.



2. Send a link to a voice recording (Vocaroo, Google Drive, or similar) of you reading these three lines naturally, as if on a real call:



"Hi, is this Mike? Mike, it's [your name] over at Local Pro Directory. I was calling to let you know that your tree service has a free listing in our Camp Hill directory. The listing allows homeowners to request quotes through it, so I'm on a quick recorded call to make sure the info is correct. Do you have a minute?"



"To send you those quote alerts, I need your consent. Is it OK to text you at the number you provided regarding your listing and quote requests? Message and data rates may apply, and you can reply STOP anytime."



"Totally fair. This isn't a website pitch, and there's no contract. It's $297 a month, cancel anytime, and the missed call tool alone usually pays for it in one job. Want me to set it up while we're on?"



3. In 3 to 5 sentences, describe your cold calling and closing experience: what you sold, to whom, and roughly how many sales you closed in a typical month.



4. In 2 to 3 sentences, describe what you have done in GoHighLevel and for which kind of business. A screenshot of a pipeline or calendar you managed is a plus.



5. Confirm you can work Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, 10:00 am to 6:30 pm US Eastern.

What You'll Be Doing

Close sales over the phone. Turn inbound inquiries into booked jobs by building rapport, asking the right questions, presenting solutions, and confidently asking for the sale.

Move fast on new leads. Contact new inquiries within 5 minutes whenever possible. Speed matters, and we don't want good leads going cold.

Follow up like a pro. Call, text, and reconnect with customers who haven't booked yet. One call is rarely enough, and you'll know when to keep the conversation going.

Turn estimates into sales. Follow up on open quotes, address concerns, overcome price objections, and help customers make a decision.

Manage a busy pipeline. Keep track of new leads, callbacks, text conversations, pending estimates, and scheduled jobs without letting opportunities slip through the cracks.

Keep the CRM updated. Record accurate notes, track every conversation, and make sure every lead has a clear next step.

Coordinate with the team. Help customers with scheduling, answer questions, and ensure a smooth experience from the first call to the booked job.

Hit your numbers. Work toward daily sales goals, strong conversion rates, and consistent performance.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for a salesperson first, not just a customer service representative.



You might be a great fit if you:

Have 2–5+ years of experience in inside sales, telesales, appointment setting, or phone-based sales.

Are comfortable spending most of your workday making and receiving calls.

Know how to handle objections, discuss pricing, and confidently ask customers to buy.

Don't give up after one unanswered call or one “not right now.”

Can manage multiple conversations and tasks without losing track of important details.

Are comfortable using CRMs, phone systems, text messaging platforms, and scheduling tools.

Communicate in clear, natural, professional English.

Take ownership of your results and don't need someone constantly reminding you what to do.

Are competitive, coachable, organized, and motivated by hitting targets.

Can take feedback, participate in call reviews, and work on improving your sales skills.

Experience in home services is a plus, but it's not required. If you've sold HVAC services, roofing, plumbing, cleaning services, insurance, automotive services, memberships, or other consumer services over the phone, we'd love to hear from you.



We can teach you our services and systems. What we can't teach as easily is the drive to pick up the phone, follow up, and close the deal.



What Success Looks Like

We want someone who takes every lead seriously and understands that every missed follow-up could mean a missed sale.



Here are the results we're working toward:



New leads contacted in under 5 minutes whenever possible.

A target booking/close rate of 50% or higher.

Consistent follow-up on every open estimate and sales opportunity.

A meaningful contribution toward JT's daily sales goal of $20,000+.

Accurate CRM records and a pipeline where no lead gets forgotten.

These are performance targets, not guarantees. Your ability to consistently execute, learn, and improve will matter.



What This Job Is NOT

Let's be clear about a few things.



This is not a passive customer service role where you answer questions and wait for the next call.

This is not a job where you send a quote and hope the customer gets back to you.

This is not a fit for someone who dislikes making outbound calls or following up multiple times.

This is not a role for someone who needs constant supervision to stay productive.

Some customers will say no. Some won't answer. Some will push back on price. That's part of sales. We need someone who stays professional, keeps moving, and knows how to create opportunities instead of waiting for them.



Why Join JT?

Work remotely from home.

Be part of a team that values initiative, accountability, and results.

Develop your phone sales, objection-handling, and closing skills.

Have clear performance goals so you know what success looks like.

Get the opportunity to make a real impact on the company's growth.

title: CRM Manager/Cold Caller Dual position
description:
# GoHighLevel CRM Specialist & Cold Caller — Surplus Funds Recovery



We are hiring a reliable virtual assistant for a **dual position managing our GoHighLevel CRM and making cold calls** for our surplus funds recovery business.



We help clients recover funds that may remain after their property is sold through foreclosure. We need one person who can prepare and upload daily leads, manage the CRM, and call potential clients.



## PAY & BONUSES



- **$3 USD per hour**, including the one-week paid trial.

- **$50 bonus for each contract approved by our legal team.**

- **A bonus equal to 5% of the net profit on each case file that pays out in the future.** This bonus is payable after the case pays out and net profit is determined.



## WORK SCHEDULE



**Tuesday through Saturday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., Colorado Mountain Time.**



You must adjust your local schedule to match these hours, including Colorado’s daylight saving time changes. Break arrangements will be confirmed.



## DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES



**8:00–9:00 a.m. — Lead Preparation and CRM Uploads**



- Download daily leads from **Excess Elite**.

- Arrange, organize, and format leads in **Excel spreadsheets** for upload into our CRM.

- Filter leads according to our criteria, remove duplicates, and flag incomplete or inaccurate information.

- Upload prepared leads into GoHighLevel with the correct fields, tags, and pipeline stages.

- Ensure leads are ready for calling immediately after upload.



**9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. — Cold Calling and Follow-Up**



- Call potential clients and clearly explain our surplus funds recovery services.

- Identify interested prospects and follow our qualification process.

- Record accurate call notes, update lead statuses, and schedule follow-ups.

- Communicate professionally and respectfully with potential clients.



## CRM MANAGEMENT



Our CRM operates on **GoHighLevel through XS Elite**. It is mostly set up and already A2P approved, but minor adjustments may be needed.



You must know how to:



- Set up, adjust, and troubleshoot automations, workflows, and triggers.

- Update CRM settings and pipelines as needed.

- Maintain accurate lead records and follow-up processes.

- Identify and resolve issues affecting daily operations.



CRM adjustments will be handled as needed alongside your daily responsibilities.



## REQUIREMENTS



- Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel CRM setup and management.

- Ability to configure and troubleshoot automations, workflows, triggers, and settings.

- Knowledge of how to download leads from Excess Elite.

- Proficiency in Excel, including organizing, filtering, formatting, and preparing lead spreadsheets for CRM imports.

- Experience accurately importing leads into GoHighLevel.

- Previous cold-calling or outbound sales experience.

- Clear spoken English and a confident, professional phone manner.

- Strong attention to detail, reliability, and follow-through.

- Reliable internet, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace.

- Availability to work the required Colorado schedule.



Experience in surplus funds recovery, foreclosure-related services, or real estate is preferred.



## ONE-WEEK PAID TRIAL



Selected applicants must complete a **one-week paid trial at $3 USD per hour**, following the schedule listed above.



During the trial, you will demonstrate that you can:



- Review our existing CRM and make necessary minor adjustments.

- Configure or adjust automations, workflows, triggers, and settings.

- Download leads from Excess Elite and prepare them in Excel.

- Filter and upload daily leads accurately into GoHighLevel.

- Make cold calls and professionally explain our services.

- Maintain accurate call notes, lead statuses, and follow-up records.



Continued employment will depend on your ability to perform both parts of the role, including your CRM skills, lead preparation, calling performance, accuracy, reliability, and professionalism.



## HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through **OnlineJobs.ph** and include:



1. A summary of your GoHighLevel experience, including automations and triggers you have set up or managed.

2. Your experience downloading leads from Excess Elite, preparing Excel spreadsheets, and uploading leads into a CRM.

3. Your cold-calling experience and any background in surplus funds recovery or related industries.

4. Confirmation that you can work **Tuesday through Saturday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., Colorado Mountain Time**, and complete the one-week paid trial.

5. Your **WhatsApp number, including country code**, so we can message shortlisted applicants for immediate interviews.



**Please apply only if you have the skills to handle BOTH CRM management and cold calling.**

Compensation

title: Shopify Page & Funnel Builder | PDPs, Advertorials & CRO
description:
We're an established DTC e-commerce company looking for an experienced Shopify Page & Funnel Builder to work with our team on an ongoing basis.



We're looking for someone with a strong eye for design who understands direct-response marketing, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and how to build pages that convert paid traffic into customers.



This isn't a generic Shopify website design role. We need someone who has experience building high-quality product pages, advertorials, listicles, and conversion-focused sales funnels for established e-commerce brands.



Our team will provide copy, creative direction, brand assets, and reference pages. You should also be able to independently recommend improvements based on your experience.



## Responsibilities



- Design, build, and optimize Shopify product detail pages (PDPs).

- Build advertorials, listicles, pre-sell pages, comparison pages, and landing pages for paid traffic.

- Develop interactive quiz funnels and other custom funnel experiences.

- Improve existing pages through better visual hierarchy, layouts, product imagery, social proof, and offer presentation.

- Build and customize pages using GemPages, Shopify, and other page builders.

- Recreate and adapt reference pages to our branding while maintaining a high standard of design.

- Implement conversion elements such as sticky ATC buttons, bundles, subscription options, testimonials, comparison sections, and FAQs.

- Create page variations for A/B testing and make improvements based on performance data.

- Ensure every page is polished, mobile-first, fast-loading, and fully functional.

- Troubleshoot technical issues and ensure compatibility with existing Shopify themes and apps.



## Requirements



- Proven experience building high-converting pages for established DTC e-commerce brands.

- Strong Shopify experience, including GemPages, Replo, PageFly, or similar page builders.

- Experience with both product pages and direct-response advertorials/listicles.

- Strong understanding of direct-response marketing, CRO principles, and customer psychology.

- Excellent design skills, especially mobile layouts, typography, spacing, and visual hierarchy.

- Ability to turn supplied copy, creative briefs, and references into professional, fully functional pages.

- Understanding of Shopify offers, product variants, cart functionality, and checkout flows.

- Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and Shopify Liquid.

- Attention to detail, reliable communication, and consistent turnaround times.



## Bonus Skills



- Experience building quiz funnels.

- Experience improving CVR, AOV, or revenue per visitor through A/B testing.

- Experience with Shopify subscriptions, bundles, and upsells.

- Ability to create custom landing-page graphics or design assets.

- Experience working with performance marketing teams or CRO agencies.



## How to Apply



Please start your application with "CRO BUILDER" and answer the following:



1. Portfolio: Share at least 3-5 actual pages you've personally built for DTC e-commerce brands. We want to see both PDPs and advertorials/listicles. Live URLs are strongly preferred.



2. Previous Brands: Which established e-commerce brands have you worked with? What was your specific contribution to each project?



3. Your Strongest Work: Which landing page or funnel are you most proud of, and why?



4. Results: Have any of your pages improved conversion rates or other performance metrics? Share examples if available.



5. Tools: Which Shopify page builders are you most experienced with?



6. Availability and Pricing: Your expected monthly salary in USD and how many hours per week you can commit.



Please only apply if you have actual experience building conversion-focused pages for DTC brands.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid trial project.



We're looking for someone who takes pride in their work, understands what makes direct-response pages convert, and can consistently deliver high-quality results.



This is an ongoing part-time position with the opportunity to take on additional responsibilities and hours as our company continues to grow.



Applications without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered.

title: Admin & Executive Support Specialist

We need someone who takes ownership, follows through, communicates clearly, keeps things organized, and makes sure nothing important falls through the cracks.



You should be comfortable working independently, handling confidential information, coordinating with different people, and managing multiple priorities at the same time.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Executive & Administrative Support

Provide day-to-day administrative support to management.

Organize and maintain important documents, records, and information.

Prepare documents, reports, summaries, trackers, and other administrative materials when needed.

Maintain organized digital folders and documentation.

Handle sensitive and confidential information professionally.



2.
 Management & Communication

 communications.

Draft professional
 responses when requested.

Organize
s, correspondence, and important information.

Follow up on unanswered or pending communications.

Help ensure important messages are not overlooked.

Maintain professional communication with employees, applicants, vendors, partners, and other contacts.



3. Calendar & Schedule Management

Maintain and organize management calendars.

Schedule meetings, appointments, interviews, and internal discussions.

Coordinate availability between participants.

Help prevent scheduling conflicts.

Send reminders for important meetings and deadlines.

Keep management informed of upcoming commitments.

Make schedule adjustments when priorities change.



4. Recruitment & Hiring Support

Create and publish job postings across approved recruitment platforms.

Source and identify qualified candidates based on the company’s hiring requirements.

Shortlist qualified candidates for management review and interviews.

Coordinate interview schedules and follow up with candidates.

Maintain an organized candidate tracker showing each applicant’s current hiring status.
