Assist with job offers, pre-employment requirements, and onboarding coordination.

Maintain an active talent pool for future hiring needs.

Provide regular updates on recruitment progress, pending interviews, and open positions.



5. Task & Follow-Up Management

Maintain an organized list of ongoing, pending, and completed tasks.

Follow up with responsible individuals regarding outstanding deliverables.

Track deadlines and commitments.

Flag overdue or potentially delayed items.

Provide management with clear status updates.

Make sure instructions are documented accurately.

Follow through on assigned tasks instead of waiting to be reminded.



6. Documentation & File Organization

Maintain a structured digital filing system.

Organize company documents so they can be easily located when needed.

Maintain administrative records and trackers.

Keep documents properly named, categorized, and updated.

Assist in documenting company procedures and administrative processes.

Help maintain internal templates, forms, checklists, and SOPs.



7. Meeting & Coordination Support

Help prepare information needed before meetings.

Coordinate meeting schedules and participants.

Take or organize meeting notes when required.

Document decisions, deliverables, and follow-up items.

Track action items after meetings.

Follow up with responsible team members regarding agreed deliverables.



8. General Operations Support

Assist management with day-to-day operational coordination.

Coordinate with different departments when administrative support is required.

Help collect updates and information requested by management.

Maintain visibility of pending administrative and operational matters.

Identify administrative issues before they become bigger problems.

Recommend improvements to administrative processes when appropriate.

Take ownership of recurring administrative responsibilities.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is:



Highly organized and detail-oriented

Proactive rather than reactive

Reliable and accountable

Comfortable working independently

Strong at following instructions

Equally comfortable asking questions when something is genuinely unclear

Able to manage multiple priorities without losing track of details

Professional in written and verbal communication

Consistent with follow-ups

Comfortable communicating with candidates and team members

Able to maintain confidentiality

Resourceful and capable of solving routine problems independently

Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities may change



REQUIRED SKILLS



Strong written and spoken English

Administrative or executive support experience

Excellent organizational and time-management skills

Professional
 communication

Calendar and scheduling management

Recruitment and candidate coordination

Candidate screening and applicant tracking

Document and file management

Task tracking and follow-up

Strong attention to detail

Ability to work with spreadsheets, documents, and online collaboration tools

Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly



Experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Virtual Assistant, Recruitment Assistant, HR Assistant, or Operations Assistant is an advantage.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE



Success is not measured simply by being online or completing isolated tasks.



A successful Admin & Executive Support Specialist helps create order, visibility, and accountability.



Management should be able to quickly understand:



What needs to be done

What has already been completed

What is currently in progress

What is delayed or requires attention

Which communications require a response

Which meetings and deadlines are coming up

Which candidates are moving through recruitment

Which positions are still open

What needs management approval or a decision



The goal is simple: keep things organized, keep things moving, and make sure important matters do not get forgotten.



WORKING STYLE

Take Ownership



If something is assigned to you, take responsibility for moving it forward.



Communicate Early



If there is a problem, delay, or missing information, communicate it before it becomes an issue.



Stay Organized



Do not rely solely on memory. Use trackers, calendars, documentation, and systems.



Follow Through



Starting a task is not the same as completing it.



Think Ahead



If you notice something that management will likely need, bring it forward proactively.



Protect Confidentiality



You may have access to management communications, company information, employee information, candidate information, and credentials. Professional discretion is essential.



BEFORE YOU APPLY

We are looking for someone who understands that this position is not simply about completing tasks as they are assigned. It is about helping management stay organized, maintaining visibility over important matters, following through consistently, and taking ownership of responsibilities.



If you are someone who waits to be reminded repeatedly, struggles to keep track of details, or requires constant supervision to complete routine responsibilities, this role may not be the right fit.



If you are organized, proactive, dependable, professional, and comfortable taking ownership, we would like to hear from you.

title: Dry Van & Reefer Freight Dispatcher — Virtual Assistant
description:
WE ARE HIRING

Dry Van & Reefer Freight Dispatcher — Virtual Assistant



Company: True Profit Dispatch  

Website: 
  

Position: U.S. Freight Dispatcher (Dry Van & Reefer)  

Engagement: Independent Contractor  

Location: 100% Remote — International Applicants Welcome  

Compensation: Proposed $6–$9 USD per hour, based on experience, plus performance-based incentives  

Availability: Must be available to coordinate dispatch activities during agreed U.S. business-hour coverage periods



About True Profit Dispatch



True Profit Dispatch is a U.S.-focused freight dispatching business specializing in helping trucking companies and owner-operators operate efficiently and profitably.



We are seeking an experienced, dependable, and highly motivated **Dry Van & Reefer Freight Dispatcher** who understands U.S. trucking markets, negotiates effectively with freight brokers, and prioritizes driver profitability.



We are not looking for someone who simply books loads. We want a dispatcher who understands the difference between keeping a truck moving and keeping a truck profitable.



Key Responsibilities



1. Load Searching and Booking

- Search DAT, Truckstop, and other authorized freight load boards.

- Find profitable loads for both dry van and refrigerated trailers.

- Evaluate rates using total miles, including loaded and deadhead miles.

- Identify strong and weak freight markets.

- Plan profitable routes and return loads.

- Verify broker credentials, payment history, and load details.

- Review rate confirmations before booking.



2. Broker Negotiations

- Communicate professionally with U.S. freight brokers by phone and
.

- Negotiate competitive rates based on current freight conditions.

- Prepare and present effective counteroffers.

- Identify opportunities for higher-paying freight.

- Negotiate detention, layover, additional stops, and other accessorial charges.

- Build productive, long-term relationships with reliable brokers.

- Avoid booking loads that do not meet agreed profitability requirements without authorization.



3. Dry Van Dispatch Operations

- Coordinate general freight shipments and delivery schedules.

- Verify equipment requirements and shipment details.

- Monitor pickup and delivery appointments.

- Coordinate with drivers regarding routes and load status.

- Resolve scheduling conflicts and report service issues.

- Monitor detention and layover opportunities.



4. Reefer Dispatch Operations

- Book temperature-controlled freight.

- Confirm commodity requirements, temperature setpoints, and reefer operating instructions.

- Coordinate reefer trailer availability, washouts, and fuel requirements.

- Monitor pickup and delivery appointments.

- Maintain accurate seal, temperature, and shipment documentation.

- Escalate temperature discrepancies and potential cargo claims.



5. Driver and Broker Communication**

- Maintain timely communication with drivers and brokers.

- Provide shipment updates and appointment confirmations.

- Coordinate delays and operational issues.

- Respect driver hours-of-service limitations.

- Escalate safety, mechanical, and compliance concerns.



6. Reporting and Administrative Support**

- Maintain accurate load records in Excel or Google Sheets.

- Update dispatch dashboards and truck availability information.

- Record gross revenue, loaded miles, deadhead, and booked RPM.

- Track detention, layover, and accessorial payments.

- Organize rate confirmations, bills of lading, and proof-of-delivery documents.

- Prepare daily status reports and weekly performance summaries.



Minimum Qualifications



- At least 1 year of U.S. freight dispatching experience preferred.

- Experience with both dry van and reefer freight strongly preferred.

- Familiarity with DAT, Truckstop, or comparable freight load boards.

- Strong knowledge of U.S. freight lanes and trucking geography.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Confident broker negotiation and telephone communication skills.

- Ability to calculate gross RPM and understand cost-per-mile profitability.

- Proficiency in Excel, Google Sheets,
, and digital communication.

- Reliable high-speed internet and professional remote work setup.

- Strong time management, problem-solving, and organizational skills.



Preferred Experience



- Dispatching owner-operators and small trucking fleets.

- Reefer commodity and temperature requirements.

- Booking profitable return loads.

- Managing multiple trucks.

- Broker credit and authority verification.

- Detention and layover recovery.

- Familiarity with the Southeast, Midwest, Texas, Northeast, and Western U.S. freight markets.



Performance Expectations



Contractor performance will be evaluated using agreed service and business outcomes, including:



- Profitability of booked freight.

- Quality of broker negotiations.

- Reduction of avoidable deadhead.

- Load documentation accuracy.

- Effective driver and broker communication.

- Appointment and shipment coordination.

- Timely reporting.

- Consistent adherence to agreed dispatch procedures and safety requirements.



Compensation and Engagement



- Proposed rate: $6–$9 USD per hour, depending on demonstrated experience.

- Performance-based bonuses may be offered under separately agreed criteria.

- Initial paid trial engagement.

- Opportunity for an ongoing service relationship.

- Independent contractor agreement required.



The contractor is responsible for applicable independent-business and tax obligations, subject to governing law.



How to Apply



Applicants should submit:



1. Resume and relevant dispatching experience.

2. Description of dry van and reefer freight experience.

3. Freight load boards previously used.

4. Number of trucks previously managed.

5. Example of a successful broker rate negotiation.

6. Expected hourly rate and U.S. business-hour availability.

7. A short response to the following scenario:



Dispatcher Assessment:



A broker offers $2,400 for a dry van load with 900 loaded miles and 100 deadhead miles. Explain how you would evaluate the load, negotiate the rate, and assess the destination market.



Application
: 



Subject: Dry Van & Reefer Dispatcher — Independent Contractor



True Profit Dispatch — Dispatching for Profit, Not Just Miles.

title: Experienced U.S. Business Credit Funding Specialist — Credit Stacking, 0% APR, Personal + Business Funding (Full-Time, R
description:
We are Developer Launch LLC, a U.S. company that helps real estate developers get funded — personal term loans, 0% APR business credit card stacking, and business lines of credit, typically $100K–$250K+ per client.



We are building our funding team IN-HOUSE and we are hiring ONE experienced funding specialist who has ALREADY done this work for a U.S. funding, credit, or financial services company. This is not a general VA role and it is not a trainee role.



## WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. **Underwrite client credit reports** (Experian / Equifax / TransUnion — SmartCredit, IdentityIQ, MyScoreIQ or similar): score by bureau, overall + per-card utilization, inquiries per bureau, new accounts, negatives, oldest account age — and call the client fundable now, optimize first, or not fundable, with reasons.

2. **Build the funding sequence per client:** personal term loans first where they fit (SoFi, Best Egg, Prosper, Upgrade, Upstart, LightStream or similar), business bank account opening + deposit seasoning, then business credit card stacking rounds in the right bank order.

3. **Run application rounds:** prepare and track applications with Chase, Amex, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, PNC, U.S. Bank, Citi, Citizens, BMO and credit unions — knowing which bureau each pulls, relationship/deposit requirements, and inquiry sensitivity BEFORE we apply.

4. **Protect the client's score through the sequence:** inquiry spacing, application order, utilization management, and keeping the client above a 680 FICO for their construction financing.

5. **Track everything** in Google Sheets / our tracker: stage, applications, approvals, limits, amounts funded, next action + date for every client. Flag stalls the same day.

6. **Talk to U.S. clients** in WhatsApp groups and on calls: clear, confident, same-day updates on exactly where their file is.



## MUST HAVE — DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT THESE

- **1+ year hands-on** doing U.S. business/personal funding, credit card stacking, or funding-company underwriting — for a real U.S. company, not coursework

- You can read a 3-bureau report and build a funding sequence from it without being taught how

- Working knowledge of: Chase 5/24 and how it treats business cards, which bureaus the major banks pull, business checking relationship/deposit requirements, EIN vs personal guarantee, aged LLC / shelf corp positioning

- Experience with SmartCredit, IdentityIQ, Credit Repair Cloud, DisputeFox, GoHighLevel or similar tools — tell us which ones

- Excellent spoken + written English, full-time availability overlapping U.S. hours (evening/night PH time), quiet call setup

- Clean, compliant approach: we NEVER guarantee funding amounts, we never submit an application a client hasn't reviewed, and we do not use CPNs, synthetic identities, or fake tradelines. If your background is in those tactics, do not apply.



## PAY

$1,000–$1,500 USD/month full-time based on verified experience, paid bi-weekly, + a bonus for every client you help get funded. Long-term role with a raise path to Funding Team Lead as we build the in-house team under you.



## TO APPLY — APPLICATIONS MISSING ANY ITEM ARE IGNORED

Put the word **FUNDING** at the very top of your application, then:

1. The U.S. funding/credit companies you worked for, your exact role, and for how long

2. The largest total funding stack you personally helped a client obtain, and what it was made of (term loans / which banks' cards / lines)

3. A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself and explaining: why do experienced operators run personal term loans BEFORE business credit cards?

4. Your answer to this, in writing: A client has a 742 Experian / 728 TransUnion / 705 Equifax, 42% overall utilization with one card at 68%, 6 Experian inquiries in the last 6 months, a 4-month-old LLC, and $18K in total card limits. Are they fundable today? What are their first 3 moves, in order?

5. Your availability for U.S.-hours overlap + earliest start date



Shortlisted candidates get a **paid trial task**: underwrite 2 sample credit reports and build the full funding sequence for each.



Thank you,

Ryan Herrera

Developer Launch LLC

title: AI Engineer
description:
About Dry Ground AI



Dry Ground AI helps mid-market companies become AI native. We design, build and run custom software, AI agents and automation workflows that operate in production for real businesses, not demos. We are a fully remote team working with clients across the U.S.



The role



We are looking for a senior AI Engineer who can own features end to end: the interface, the backend, the integrations and the AI behavior behind them. You are a strong software engineer first, with the judgment to apply AI where it creates real business leverage.



This is a generalist role. You will move between client projects as priorities shift, so we value people who can hit the ground running, pick up a new codebase quickly and keep momentum when switching from project A to project B.



Quality and security are part of how we build, not a separate step. Our engineers ship through Kaiken, our AI-assisted delivery workflow, with automated tests, Playwright end-to-end checks and security scanning on every change. You write the tests that prove your feature works.



What you will do



• Design, build and ship full-stack applications with React and TypeScript on the front end and Node.js or Python on the backend

• Build AI agents, conversational interfaces and multi-step workflows using LLM APIs and frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph

• Connect AI systems to the tools our clients run on: CRMs, property management and CMS platforms, data sources and internal tools, through REST APIs, webhooks and automation platforms such as n8n

• Plan how each new feature will be tested, then write and maintain the automated tests and evaluations for it

• Design for production: authentication and permissions, observability, error handling, and performance under real user load

• Work directly with engagement managers and clients to scope solutions, estimate effort and explain technical tradeoffs in plain language

• Review code and help raise engineering standards across the team



What we are looking for



• 5 or more years as a full-stack or senior software engineer

• Strong JavaScript and TypeScript, with hands-on React experience

• Backend experience with Node.js and/or Python, including API design and integrations

• AI features you have shipped to production and supported, not only prototypes

• Working knowledge of LLM tooling (OpenAI or Anthropic APIs, LangChain or similar), prompt and context design, and retrieval-augmented generation

• Habit of writing automated tests; experience with Playwright, Cypress or similar

• Daily use of AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code or Cursor, with Git and GitHub

• Fluent written and spoken English; you will join client calls and write client-facing updates



Nice to have



• Security experience: secure coding, secrets management, access control, dependency scanning

• CI/CD and cloud deployment, ideally AWS (GitHub Actions, containers, managed databases)

• Capacity planning and scaling, such as moving a system from SQLite to Postgres or handling traffic spikes

• Vector databases, embeddings, OCR or document-extraction pipelines

• Voice AI, real-time or event-driven systems

• Consulting or agency background with direct client delivery



What we offer



• Competitive compensation with performance-based bonuses

• Fully remote, flexible schedule

• High ownership: your decisions shape how our systems are built

• Real AI systems in production across multiple industries

• Training and development support



How to apply



• Please submit your resume and portfolio with two or three relevant examples of your work.

• Submit a 1 to 2 minute video explaining to a non-technical business owner what an AI agent is and how it could help their business.

title: Healthcare Staffing Recruiter – Philippines
description:

We are seeking an experienced, motivated Philippines-based Healthcare Staffing Recruiter to join our growing team. This position will focus on recruiting qualified healthcare professionals for opportunities with healthcare facilities throughout the United States.



This is a full-time, 100% remote position with a competitive base salary and a generous commission structure that provides significant earning potential.



** MUST HAVE ABILITY TO CALL/TEXT PEOPLE IN THE US **



Key Responsibilities

Recruit & Source Healthcare Professionals

• Source qualified RNs, LPNs, CNAs, Medical Assistants and other healthcare professionals using job boards, applicant databases, social media, referrals and other recruiting tools.

• Proactively identify and recruit both active and passive candidates.

• Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified healthcare professionals.

• Develop relationships with candidates and maintain consistent communication throughout the recruiting process.

• Match candidates with healthcare assignments based on their experience, qualifications, availability and location.



Screen & Qualify Candidates

• Conduct initial candidate interviews and screenings.

• Evaluate candidates' experience, skills, availability and suitability for specific healthcare assignments.

• Verify required licenses, certifications, credentials and other qualifications as applicable.

• Collect required candidate documentation and ensure candidate information is complete and accurate.

• Clearly communicate assignment details, schedules, compensation and other requirements to candidates.



Manage the Recruiting Process

• Work closely with the Workforce Management recruiting and staffing team to understand client requirements and staffing needs.

• Identify and present qualified candidates for open healthcare positions.

• Maintain regular communication and follow up with candidates throughout the recruiting and placement process.

• Track recruiting activity, candidate status and placements in the company's ATS/CRM.

• Follow company recruiting, compliance and documentation procedures.

• Work within MSP/VMS platforms and processes when applicable.



Build the Candidate Network

• Continuously develop and expand a database of qualified healthcare professionals.

• Establish long-term relationships with healthcare professionals for current and future opportunities.

• Utilize creative sourcing strategies to identify qualified healthcare talent, including candidates who may not be actively looking for a new opportunity.



Requirements



Healthcare Recruiting Experience:

At least 2 years of healthcare staffing or healthcare recruiting experience is preferred, but we will consider candidates with strong relevant U.S. healthcare recruiting experience.



U.S. Healthcare Experience:

Experience recruiting healthcare professionals for U.S. hospitals, healthcare facilities, nursing facilities, clinics, home healthcare organizations or staffing agencies is strongly preferred.



MSP/VMS Experience:

Experience working with Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and Vendor Management Systems (VMS) in the U.S. healthcare staffing industry is preferred. Candidates who have experience recruiting and filling healthcare positions through MSP/VMS programs will be particularly valued.



ShiftMed Experience – Strong Plus:

Previous experience working with ShiftMed, either directly or through a staffing agency, is a significant advantage. Familiarity with ShiftMed's staffing model, workflows, candidate requirements and/or VMS environment will be considered a strong plus.



Healthcare Professionals:

Experience recruiting RNs, LPNs, CNAs, Medical Assistants, allied health professionals or other clinical healthcare professionals is highly desirable.



English Communication:

Excellent verbal and written English communication skills are required. The ability to communicate professionally and confidently with U.S.-based healthcare professionals and clients is essential.



Recruiting Skills:

Strong candidate sourcing, interviewing, follow-up, relationship-building and closing skills.



Technology:

Reliable computer/laptop, mobile phone and high-speed internet connection.



ATS/CRM Experience:

Experience working with an applicant tracking system (ATS), CRM or recruiting database is strongly preferred.



Schedule:

Full-time, Monday–Friday, working U.S. Central Time (CT) hours to support our clients and candidates. The schedule may be adjusted slightly, as needed, based on business requirements and candidate availability.



Mindset:

Self-motivated, organized, persistent, goal-oriented and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.



Track Record:

A demonstrated history of successfully recruiting and placing healthcare professionals is strongly preferred.



What We Offer

• $1,000+ per month base compensation, based on experience and qualifications

• Generous commission structure for successful placements

• Unlimited earning potential

• Full-time, 100% remote position

• Access to recruiting tools, applicant databases and job boards

• Opportunity to work with a growing U.S. healthcare staffing company

• Opportunity to work with MSP/VMS healthcare staffing programs

• Opportunity for career advancement into a Senior Recruiter or Recruiting Manager position

• Opportunity to help build and lead a growing healthcare recruiting team

• Long-term opportunity for successful recruiters who consistently deliver results



How to Apply



To be considered for this position, please provide the following:



1. Updated Resume

Please include your healthcare recruiting experience, the types of healthcare professionals you have recruited, and your experience recruiting for the U.S. market.



2. Professional References

Please provide at least two professional references from current or previous employers, staffing agencies or clients who can speak to your healthcare recruiting experience and performance.



3. Short Introduction Video

Please record a brief 1–2 minute video introducing yourself and explaining:

 • Your healthcare recruiting experience

 • The types of healthcare professionals you have recruited

 • Your experience recruiting for the U.S. healthcare market

 • Your recruiting accomplishments or placement experience

 • Why you believe you would be a strong fit for Workforce Management Inc.



We are looking for recruiters who are motivated, results-driven and interested in building a long-term career with a growing U.S. staffing company.

title: Multimedia Designer & Video Editor
description:

We are looking for a talented, versatile, and detail-oriented Multimedia Designer & Video Editor to join our growing creative team.

We want someone with a strong creative eye, a good understanding of visual communication, and the ability to turn ideas and instructions into polished, professional work.



This is a full-time, long-term opportunity for someone who values stability, consistency, and professional growth.

Website-related tasks will be occasional and secondary to graphic design and video production.

- Strong understanding of typography, color theory, layout, and visual hierarchy.

- Experience working with US-based brands or businesses.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted creative tools and workflows.

- Is equally comfortable working on graphic design and video editing projects.

- Has a strong creative eye and understands modern design trends.

- Can produce quality work without constant supervision.

- Is organized, dependable, and able to manage multiple assignments.

- Accepts feedback professionally and applies revisions efficiently.

- Takes initiative and pays attention to details.

Applicants must be comfortable consistently working overnight hours in the Philippines and maintaining reliable communication with a US-based team.



TOOLS & EQUIPMENT



Applicants must have:

- Access to the required creative applications.

title: Independent Facility Sales Representative

WE ARE HIRING

Independent Facility Sales Representative



Remote | Independent Contractor | U.S. Healthcare Staffing Sales



Company: Main Forte Staffing  

Company Location: Palm Bay, Florida, USA  

Work Location: Remote — Philippines-based applicants welcome  

Contract Type: Independent Contractor  

Initial Contract: 30-Day Paid Trial



 Compensation



₱25,000–₱35,000 per month + performance-based commissions**



- Preferred starting offer: ₱30,000 monthly contractor service fee.

- Qualified sales meeting bonus: ₱1,000 per completed, qualified meeting.

- New facility acquisition commission: 10% of collected gross profit generated during the new facility's first four weeks of staffing services.

- Payment terms: Established in the written independent contractor agreement.

- Contract renewal: Based on performance and mutual agreement.



This is a negotiated independent contractor service fee, not an employee salary. Actual compensation will depend on qualifications, experience, agreed scope, and verified results.



About Main Forte Staffing



Main Forte Staffing is a Florida-based healthcare staffing company focused on connecting qualified Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs) and Home Health Aides (HHAs) with healthcare facilities that need dependable staffing support.



We are seeking an experienced, confident, and results-oriented Independent Facility Sales Representative to identify prospective facility clients, build relationships with decision-makers, and generate new staffing business.



This is a professional B2B sales position—not an entry-level virtual assistant or data-entry role.



Key Responsibilities



Facility Prospecting and Lead Generation

- Research healthcare facilities throughout Florida.

- Identify administrators, Directors of Nursing, HR managers, and staffing coordinators.

- Contact nursing homes, assisted living facilities, rehabilitation centers, and other appropriate healthcare organizations.

- Qualify facilities with potential CNA and HHA staffing requirements.



Sales and Business Development

- Conduct outbound calls and professional
 outreach.

- Present Main Forte Staffing's services with confidence and professionalism.

- Identify staffing shortages and temporary coverage needs.

- Handle common objections and develop relationships with facility decision-makers.

- Follow up with prospects and advance qualified opportunities toward proposals and service agreements.

- Coordinate negotiations and contract discussions with authorized management.



Client Relationship Development

- Schedule qualified meetings with facility decision-makers.

- Identify facility vendor-registration requirements.

- Maintain professional follow-up communications.

- Coordinate successful client handoffs to Main Forte Staffing management.



CRM and Sales Reporting

- Update the Facility CRM and Sales Pipeline accurately.

- Document decision-maker contacts, staffing needs, objections, and next steps.

- Provide agreed progress and performance reports.

- Maintain confidentiality and protect company information.



Required Qualifications



- Proven experience in U.S. B2B sales, outbound prospecting, or business development.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Strong telephone confidence and professional communication.

- Demonstrated experience handling objections and difficult sales conversations.

- Ability to communicate with U.S. business owners, administrators, and management personnel.

- Experience using CRM software or sales tracking systems.

- Strong follow-up and relationship-building skills.

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet calling environment.

- Ability to coordinate with prospects during appropriate U.S. business hours while independently managing work.



Preferred Qualifications



- Previous U.S. healthcare staffing sales experience.

- Experience selling services to nursing homes, assisted living facilities, or rehabilitation centers.

- Experience securing new staffing accounts or service agreements.

- Familiarity with CNA/HHA staffing needs and healthcare facility vendor onboarding.

- Proven ability to generate qualified meetings and advance opportunities through the sales process.



Initial 30-Day Performance Objectives



During the initial engagement, the representative will work toward the following objectives:



- Research and verify 40–60 potential facility clients.

- Develop 8–12 meaningful decision-maker conversations.

- Generate 3–5 qualified sales meetings.

- Identify opportunities for proposals and service agreements.

- Maintain accurate CRM and Sales Pipeline documentation.



These objectives are used to evaluate the trial and do not constitute guaranteed sales outcomes.



Independent Contractor Arrangement



The representative will provide services under a written Independent Contractor Agreement and generally retain control over their working methods and schedule.



Main Forte Staffing retains final authority over pricing, staffing commitments, contract approval, and execution.



How to Apply



Interested candidates should provide:



1. Updated resume highlighting U.S. B2B sales experience.

2. A brief summary of past sales achievements, including qualified meetings or accounts acquired.

3. A 60–90-second English voice introduction demonstrating professional sales communication.

4. Expected monthly service fee within the advertised compensation range.

5. Availability for an online interview and live sales role-play.



Company Website: 



Main Forte Staffing

Building Reliable Healthcare Staffing Partnerships

title: Experienced Medical Billing Specialist
description:

$5.00 per hour + Performance Bonus

Full-Time | Remote

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time



Important: Please Read Before Applying



Dubin Law Group is seeking an experienced Medical Billing Specialist to support our personal injury team.



Applicants must have recent, hands-on experience performing the medical billing cycle, including areas such as claim submission, denial resolution, payment posting, EOB/ERA review, accounts receivable, and insurance follow-up.



Insurance claims-processing experience alone is not sufficient. This is NOT an insurance claims representative, claims intake, or general customer-service position.



Legal experience is NOT required. We will train the selected candidate on personal injury workflows, Letters of Representation, liens, subrogation, and Filevine.



General virtual-assistant, legal-assistant, medical-records, appointment-setting, intake, or administrative experience without substantial medical billing experience does not qualify.

You will use your medical billing knowledge to review medical bills, provider ledgers, EOBs, insurance payments, adjustments, balances, liens, and reimbursement information for personal injury cases.

Track health-insurance liens, subrogation claims, and reimbursement interests.



Update balances, billing information, notes, and supporting documentation in Filevine.

Escalate complex billing, lien, or reimbursement issues when necessary.



Manage multiple cases, requests, and deadlines while working independently.





Required Medical Billing Experience:

Experience performing multiple parts of the medical billing cycle, including:



Insurance eligibility and benefits verification.



Charge entry or claim preparation.



Medical claim submission.



Rejected-claim correction and resubmission.



Denial follow-up and resolution.



Appeals or reconsiderations.



EOB and ERA review.



Insurance and patient payment posting.



Accounts-receivable and aging follow-up.



Billing-discrepancy and underpayment resolution.



Communication with insurance payers regarding reimbursement issues.



Experience with health-insurance payers, such as commercial insurance, Medicare, or Medicaid.



Ability to read and understand medical bills, EOBs, ledgers, adjustments, balances, and insurance terminology.



Strong attention to detail and accuracy.



Strong written and spoken English communication skills.



Excellent organization, follow-up, and time-management skills.



Ability to work independently in a remote environment.





Preferred Qualifications:



Broad medical billing experience across multiple specialties or payer types.



Experience reviewing provider ledgers and detailed balance statements.



Experience negotiating or tracking medical liens.



Experience with health-insurance subrogation or reimbursement claims.



Experience communicating directly with medical providers and insurance companies.



Experience with Filevine or similar case-management software.



Medical lien negotiation and personal injury experience are valuable advantages, but they do not replace the required medical billing background.





Remote-Work Requirements:



Available Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time.



Reliable high-speed internet connection.



Quiet and professional work environment.



Personal computer capable of supporting cloud-based software and multiple browser tabs.



Reliable backup plan for internet or power interruptions.







Why Join Dubin Law Group?



Stable, full-time remote position.



Performance bonus opportunities.



Long-term growth potential.



Supportive and collaborative team.



Opportunity to apply medical billing expertise within personal injury law.



Training on liens, subrogation, Filevine, and legal case workflows.

 your resume to 
 line: Medical Billing Specialist – [Your Name]





Applications showing only insurance claims processing, legal assistance, medical-record retrieval, intake, appointment setting, or general VA experience will not be considered.

title: Senior Operations VA
description:

We operate a 30+ unit Airbnb/STR portfolio across multiple US markets. Our AI messaging system already handles routine guest messages. We are NOT hiring someone to answer messages. We are hiring someone to solve the problems the AI can't — the locked-out guest at 9PM, the cleaner who didn't show, the vendor who quoted double, the damage claim that needs evidence assembled.

This role comes with real decision-making authority. You will have written authority limits (e.g, approve vendor spend up to a set amount, guest issues) and you are expected to USE them without asking permission. In this company, you will never be penalized for making a reasonable decision within your authority. You WILL be coached if you escalate things you had the authority to d
 yourself.

Top performers are compensated above market and given increasing ownership as we scale — our next team lead will be promoted from this role, not hired externally.

Must-Haves (do not apply without these)

* You already live a night-shift lifestyle. Shifts are 9 hours within 7AM–8PM PST (roughly 10PM–11AM Philippine time). Do not apply if you plan to "adjust" — we only hire people who have ALREADY worked graveyard/US hours for 6+ months and can tell us how they sustain it. This is a hard filter; our last several departures were all sleep-schedule failures.

* 1+ year hands-on STR/Airbnb operations experience (guest issues, cleaner coordination, OTA platforms). PMS/channel manager familiarity.

* Airbnb claims/AirCover experience strongly preferred.

* Strong spoken English — this role makes multiple phone calls daily to US-based guests, cleaners, and vendors. You must be comfortable picking up the phone without being told to.

* Comfortable being the most senior person online during your shift. There is no manager to hand problems off to.

Key Responsibilities

* Own all guest issues the AI escalates: access problems, WiFi, appliances, complaints, special requests — resolve end-to-end

* Coordinate cleaners: scheduling, confirmations, photo QC, same-day turnover problems

* Manage vendors and maintenance: source quotes, schedule, follow up, verify completion

* Handle Airbnb claims and damage documentation

* Maintain calendar accuracy across Airbnb, VRBO, 
, and direct bookings

* Convert every escalation into a documented rule/SOP so the same problem never needs an owner decision twice

* Weekend coverage required (especially Sunday/Monday mornings PST)

Work Setup

Remote, full-time, 2 days off per week. 9-hour shift within the 7AM–8PM PST window (exact shift set at hiring). [
a month paid bi-weekly depending on experience], performance raises reviewed at 90 days.

Scaledforce is a Canadian staffing company that helps growing Canadian businesses scale by hiring top-tier remote professionals. We focus on long-term placements, clear KPIs, and strong support so our tea
mbers can build stable, fulfilling and rewarding careers.



About the Client

You'll be supporting the two founders of a well-established Canadian staffing and consulting firm based in Toronto. They run a highly systemised, fast-moving business, and they're the kind of leaders people want to work for: patient teachers with high standards, who invest in training, tooling, and growth for their team. They automate anything that can be automated, document their processes, and give their people the systems and support to do great work. This is a company that has kept the same right-hand EA for years at a time because they know how to set the right person up to win.



Job Overview

We're looking for a full-time, remote Executive Assistant to become the operational right hand to both founders. This is a blended role: you'll run two demanding executive calendars and inboxes and own a broad, varied administrative workload that keeps the business moving behind the scenes.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to be handed a narrow checklist and told exactly what to do all day. It's for a confident, self-managing operator who thrives on variety, builds their own systems, and stays calm when they're switching between very different tasks. The founders manage their own time down to the 15-minute block, use tools like ClickUp and Calendly, and will meet with you regularly, drip responsibilities to you as you master them, and give you SOPs to follow. The learning curve is real, and the people who succeed here lean into it rather than get overwhelmed by it.

This role starts as an executor and is built to grow. As you learn how each founder thinks, you'll take on more ownership and judgment over time.



Work Schedule

• Monday to Friday

• Aligned to Eastern Time (Toronto) business hours

• Philippine Time: approximately 9:00 PM – 5:00 AM PHT (night shift)

Please only apply if you're able to reliably work night shift long-term.



Salary & Incentives

Base Salary PHP 42,000 – 46,000 per month

Quarterly Performance-based quarterly bonuses



Key Responsibilities

Executive Support (Two Founders)

• Calendar orchestration — Manage two busy, highly structured executive calendars, protect focus time, and keep both founders' days running smoothly — coordinating across their schedules without dropping a beat.

• Inbox management — Triage and organise both inboxes, draft replies for review, and gradually take over sending on their behalf as you learn their voice and judgment.

• Meeting prep — Prepare briefing materials and agendas, and make sure both founders walk into every meeting ready.

title: Experienced U.S. Credit Repair & Optimization Specialist — Disputes, Inquiries, Utilization (Full-Time, Remote PH)
description:
We are Developer Launch LLC, a U.S. company that helps real estate developers get funded $100K–$250K+. Most clients are not fundable on day one — they need 30–180 days of credit optimization first. We are hiring ONE experienced credit repair / optimization specialist to run that pipeline in-house.



This is a specialist role. General VAs and trainees: please do not apply.



## WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. **Audit 3-bureau reports** (SmartCredit / IdentityIQ / similar) and build a written optimization plan per client: what gets disputed, what gets paid down, what just needs time — and the date they become fundable.

2. **Run disputes end-to-end:** hard inquiry disputes, late payments, charge-offs, collections — letters, bureau rounds, tracking, and follow-up until results land. Tools: Credit Repair Cloud, DisputeFox, or similar (tell us which you've used).

3. **Manage utilization paydown plans:** per-card targets under 30% (and under 10% where it moves the score fastest), sequenced against the client's funding date.

4. **Handle the seasoning runway:** clients with new accounts, thin files, or recent negatives get a month-by-month plan — no new applications, no new inquiries, exact actions per month.

5. **Report weekly per client:** starting score by bureau → current score, items removed, items pending, projected fundable date. All tracked in Google Sheets.

6. **Talk to U.S. clients** in WhatsApp and on calls, in excellent English, with clear next steps — never vague "we're working on it."



## MUST HAVE — DO NOT APPLY WITHOUT THESE

- **1+ year hands-on** U.S. credit repair for a real company: dispute rounds, bureau responses, inquiry removal, re-investigations

- Working knowledge of FCRA basics: what can and cannot legally be disputed, Metro 2, the difference between removing an inquiry and disputing accurate information

- You know the timelines cold: how long a dispute round actually takes, how utilization changes report, when a paid collection helps and when it doesn't

- Tools: SmartCredit, IdentityIQ, Credit Repair Cloud, DisputeFox, client portals — list yours

- Excellent spoken + written English, full-time, U.S.-hours overlap (evening/night PH time), quiet call setup

- **Compliance-clean, non-negotiable:** we do NOT promise to delete accurate information, we do NOT guarantee score increases or funding, no CPNs, no synthetic files, no purchased authorized-user tradeline schemes. Specialists who sell those tactics will be rejected.



## PAY

$900–$1,400 USD/month full-time based on verified experience, paid bi-weekly, + performance bonuses tied to clients who graduate from optimization to funded. Long-term role, raise path to Optimization Team Lead.



## TO APPLY — APPLICATIONS MISSING ANY ITEM ARE IGNORED

Put the word **OPTIMIZE** at the very top of your application, then:

1. The U.S. credit repair / funding companies you worked for, your exact role, and for how long

2. Your best verified result: a client's starting and ending scores, how long it took, and what you actually did (be specific — dispute types, rounds, paydown)

3. A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself and explaining: a client sits at 42% overall utilization with ONE card at 68% — why does that one card hurt more than the overall number, and what do you do first?

4. Your answer to this, in writing: A client has a 2-year-old 30-day late payment on Experian only, a paid collection on all three bureaus, and 6 inquiries from rate-shopping an auto loan in one month. Which of these do you dispute, which do you route around, and which do you leave alone — and why?

5. Your availability for U.S.-hours overlap + earliest start date



Shortlisted candidates get a **paid trial task**: audit one sample 3-bureau report and deliver the full 90-day optimization plan.



Thank you,

Ryan Herrera

Developer Launch LLC

title: Shortform Video Editor
description:
Role Overview



We’re looking for a video editor to produce high-volume, short-form direct response content for our clients. You’ll turn raw footage (UGC, founder-led, product demos, testimonials, and B-roll) into ads and organic clips built to stop the scroll, hold attention, and drive a measurable action. You’ll work closely with the strategy, creative, and media buying teams, and your work will be judged on performance as well as polish.



PLEASE ATTACH PORTFOLIO OF WORK IN YOUR APPLICATION



What You’ll Work On

1. Short-Form Content Creation:

Edit primarily for vertical formats (9:16 for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts; 4:5 and 1:1 for feed placements), with 16:9 cutdowns when needed.

Build multiple variations from a single shoot: different hooks, different body orders, and different lengths (6s, 15s, 30s, 60s+).

Work from briefs and scripts, but make editorial calls on pacing, emphasis, and structure.

Produce captions, text overlays, and on-screen graphics that are readable on a phone and suited to muted viewing.

Export to platform specs and maintain a clean, consistent file naming and versioning system.

Turn winning ads into iterations (new hooks, new intros, resized versions, and extended cuts) based on performance data.



2. Working in Click Up:

Pick up tasks from the content calendar and move them through the production stages (Briefed → In Edit → Internal Review → Client Review → Approved → Delivered).

Keep task status, due dates, and time estimates current so the team can plan capacity.

Attach each delivered version to its task, with a consistent naming convention (client, concept, version, date, and aspect ratio).

Respond to feedback in task comments and resolve revision requests one at a time, linking to the exact timestamp in the video.

Use subtasks for each variation or aspect ratio so nothing gets missed at export.

Flag blockers early (missing footage, unclear brief, awaiting assets) rather than letting tasks stall.



3. Cuts and Editorial Fundamentals:

Pacing: Remove dead air, tighten pauses, and cut every few seconds where the content allows. Pacing should match the platform and the message.

Cut types: Use jump cuts for energy, J-cuts and L-cuts to carry audio across shots, match cuts for transitions, and cut on action for smooth movement.

B-roll and cutaways: Cover jump cuts and visualize claims. Keep B-roll relevant to the spoken line, and never let it compete with the message.

Continuity: Keep eyelines, screen direction, and audio levels consistent across shots.

Audio: Clean dialogue, balance music under voice, duck music around key lines, and use sound effects to punctuate cuts and on-screen text.

Reframing: Reframe horizontal footage for vertical formats while keeping the subject centered and the framing intentional.

Speed: Use speed ramps and time remapping sparingly for emphasis, not as a default.



4. Color Grading:

Correction first: Balance exposure, white balance, and contrast, and match shots from the same session before grading creatively.

Skin tones: Use the vectorscope and waveform/parade to keep skin natural. This is non-negotiable for testimonial and talking-head content.

Primary and secondary grading: Use lift/gamma/gain for overall balance, and qualifiers, power windows, and masks for targeted adjustments such as brightening a product or taming a background.

LUTs: Use LUTs as a starting point, never as a finished look. Adjust them per shot.

Consistency: Keep a single look across a campaign and across variations so the brand reads as one identity.

Delivery: Export in the correct color space for social platforms (typically Rec. 709 SDR) and check how the final grade looks on a phone.



5. VFX and Motion Graphics:

Compositing basics: Green screen keying, masking, and layering product shots or screen recordings onto devices and backgrounds.

Tracking and stabilization: Track text, graphics, and product overlays to moving subjects, and stabilize shaky handheld footage when needed.

Cleanup: Remove distractions (mic stands, reflections, unwanted objects, and blemishes) efficiently.

Motion graphics: Build lower-thirds, animated captions, callouts, price tags, and star ratings that match the brand’s template.

Restraint: Direct response VFX should be fast to read and quick to produce. Effects should serve the offer, not show off the editor.

Tools: Fusion (inside DaVinci Resolve) and After Effects for more complex work, with templates to keep production fast.



6. Direct Response Best Practices:

Hook (first 0–3 seconds): The hook d
 whether anyone watches. Lead with the problem, a bold claim, a visual pattern interrupt, or a question the viewer already has. Test multiple hooks on the same body.

Structure: Common frameworks include Hook → Problem → Agitate → Solution → Proof → Offer → CTA. Know which one the brief calls for and edit to it.

Retention: Watch for drop-off points. If viewers leave at a specific moment, fix the edit there (tighten, add a visual change, or move the strongest line earlier).

Proof: Surface social proof, testimonials, and before/after evidence early enough to build trust before the offer.

Offer clarity: The price, benefit, or deal should be understandable in a single glance. Don’t bury it.

Call to action: End with a clear, specific CTA on screen and in voice, matching the landing page or offer.

Captions: Most viewers watch with sound off. Burn in captions with clear timing, high contrast, and safe placement.

Safe zones: Keep key text and faces clear of platform UI elements (profile icons, captions, and action buttons).

Testing: Build ads for testing, not just for approval. Create controlled variations (one change at a time where possible) and feed performance back into the next round.

Platform fit: Native-feeling, UGC-style editing usually outperforms polished brand spots on social. Adjust style by platform and placement.

Compliance: Follow Meta, TikTok, and Google ad policies on claims, before/after content, and prohibited categories.



What Success Looks Like:

Deliveries land on time, with clean files and complete variation sets.

Hooks and structures are tested and iterated based on performance data, not just taste.

Revision rounds are shrinking over time because the editor’s first cut is close to approved.

ClickUp stays accurate enough that the team can plan without asking for status updates.

title: Ecommerce Order Management & Customer Support Specialist - Shopify
description:
ECOMMERCE ORDER MANAGEMENT & CUSTOMER SUPPORT SPECIALIST



Full-time | Remote, Philippines

US$1,000–$1,200/month, depending on relevant experience

Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Toronto time



ABOUT US



Bathify and Haum are North American ecommerce brands selling bathroom, kitchen, furniture, and home products.



We’re looking for an experienced, dependable person to help manage customer orders from purchase through delivery and resolve issues along the way.



This role combines customer service with detailed operational follow-through. You will speak with customers, coordinate with suppliers and shipping partners, keep records accurate, and take responsibility for moving open issues toward resolution.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Answer customer inquiries by phone,
, and live chat with clear, professional communication.



• Review and process orders, confirming product details, availability, and fulfillment requirements.



• Coordinate with suppliers, warehouses, and carriers to keep orders moving.



• Track outstanding orders, backorders, shipment delays, and delivery appointments.



• Proactively update customers when timelines change.



• Handle damaged or missing items, returns, cancellations, replacements, and refund requests according to company policies and approval limits.



• Collect the information needed to resolve claims, including photos, product details, and shipping documents.



• Maintain accurate order notes, customer records, and follow-up tasks in Shopify and our support systems.



• Escalate issues with a clear summary of what happened, what you have checked, and the next action you recommend.



• Keep ownership of open cases until they are resolved or clearly handed over.



WHAT WE NEED



• At least two years of relevant ecommerce customer support or order management experience.



• Hands-on experience using Shopify to review and manage customer orders.



• Previous experience supporting customers by phone.



• Strong spoken and written English. You must be able to explain an issue clearly, listen carefully, and handle difficult conversations professionally.



• Strong attention to detail when working with order numbers, SKUs, quantities, addresses, and shipping information.



• Experience following up with suppliers, warehouses, carriers, or other external partners.



• Good judgement: You know when to investigate, when to follow policy, and when to escalate.



• Strong organization and the ability to manage multiple open cases without losing track of commitments.



• Ability to work independently after training and communicate early when you encounter a blocker.



• A quiet workspace, suitable headset, reliable internet, and a practical backup plan for internet or power interruptions.



EXPERIENCE THAT WOULD BE ESPECIALLY USEFUL



• Furniture, home improvement, bathroom, kitchen, or other large-item ecommerce.

• Freight/LTL deliveries and delivery appointments.

• Shipping damage claims and replacement coordination.

• Customer support platforms such as Gorgias, Zendesk, or similar tools.

• Supporting customers in Canada or the United States.



SCHEDULE



You must be available Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m. Toronto time, with breaks coordinated to maintain customer coverage.



The schedule follows Toronto’s daylight-saving changes. In the Philippines, this is generally:



• 9 p.m.–5 a.m. when Toronto observes daylight time.

• 10 p.m.–6 a.m. when Toronto observes standard time.



Phone support is a required part of the role. This schedule must be compatible with your other commitments.



WHAT GOOD PERFORMANCE LOOKS LIKE



• Customers receive accurate answers and timely updates.

• Orders and open cases have clear notes, next steps, and follow-up dates.

• Delays and problems are identified early.

• Refunds, replacements, and customer commitments follow company policy.

• You follow through on commitments without needing repeated reminders.

• You communicate honestly when something is unknown and take action to find the answer.



HOW TO APPLY



Use the subject line:

Order & CX Specialist — [Your Name]



Please include all of the following:



1. RELEVANT EXPERIENCE



Briefly describe your ecommerce support and order management experience, including:

• The types of products you supported.

• Your responsibilities in Shopify.

• Your phone support experience.

• The support platforms you have used.



2. SHORT VOICE RECORDING



Share a 60–90 second recording introducing yourself and explaining a customer issue you personally helped resolve.



Use a link that we can open without requesting access. Do not include customer names or confidential information. A clear phone recording is sufficient.



3. TWO SHORT SCENARIO ANSWERS



Scenario A:

A customer calls because their vanity has not arrived. Shopify shows the order as fulfilled, but the tracking has not updated for four days. The customer’s contractor is scheduled for tomorrow.



What would you say to the customer, what would you check, and what would you do next?



Scenario B:

A customer reports a damaged countertop and demands a full refund today. They have provided one blurry photo, and you do not have authority to approve the refund.



Write the short
 you would send and list your next internal steps.



Keep each scenario answer under 150 words. We want your own judgement and natural wording; polished language alone will not determine who progresses.



4. AVAILABILITY AND EXPECTATIONS



Confirm:

• Your expected monthly salary in USD.

• Your earliest start date.

• That you can work the stated Toronto schedule year-round.

• Your internet and power backup arrangements.

• Any other work commitments that overlap with this schedule.



5. RESUME



Attach your resume or provide a link.



Applications must include the requested information to be considered. Shortlisted applicants will complete a live conversation and a brief role-play using a fictional customer situation.

title: Lead Generation & Web Scraping Wizard | Apify, AI & Data Enrichment
description:
We’re looking for a serious lead generation and web scraping expert who knows how to find almost anyone on the internet.



We want someone who understands Apify, web scraping, APIs, AI-powered data extraction, and creative methods of finding highly targeted business leads.



We're not looking for someone who simply downloads lists from Apollo or runs a basic scraper. We're looking for someone who understands **how to discover, extract, organize, enrich, and accurately qualify leads at scale.**



What You'll Be Doing



Lead Discovery: Find highly targeted businesses and decision-makers across different industries using creative research methods.



Web Scraping: Use Apify, custom scrapers, APIs, search engines, directories, Google Maps, social media, and other sources to discover leads.



AI-Powered Classification: Analyze business descriptions, websites, bios, and other text to identify exactly what each business specializes in.



Specialty Identification: For example, distinguish general contractors from concrete contractors, foundation specialists, custom home builders, developers, and remodeling companies.



Lead Qualification: Build reliable systems that identify which leads meet specific criteria and which should be excluded.



Data Enrichment: Find business websites, relevant contacts, verified
s, phone numbers, locations, and other useful information.



Automation: Create repeatable workflows that continuously find, classify, deduplicate, and organize new leads.



Skills We're Looking For



- Strong experience with **Apify and its Actors**

- Python, JavaScript, or similar scraping experience

- Experience with APIs, browser automation, and structured data extraction

- AI/LLM experience using tools like OpenAI or Gemini to classify and interpret text

- Experience with data enrichment, deduplication, and lead scoring

- Creative problem-solving and the ability to discover new lead sources

- Understanding of how to measure and improve classification accuracy



How to Apply - IMPORTANT



Please do not send a generic application.



We want to understand how you think and solve problems.



In your application, please answer the following:



1. How would you find leads?



Imagine we wanted to find every concrete contractor, foundation specialist, and residential builder in three specific counties.



Walk us through your process. What websites, tools, APIs, scraping methods, and search strategies would you use?



2. How would you identify specialties?**

4. How would you scale it?

We value creativity, technical ability, accuracy, and results.



If you're the kind of person who loves figuring out how to find hard-to-find information and turn messy internet data into highly organized, qualified leads, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Land Comper / Land Analyst (Land Insights, LandPortal, Smarter Contact) - Ridge Capital
description:
SALARY: $700-$900 USD per month starting base + $100 per closed deal  |  Full time, 40 hours/week  |  Hiring 2



ABOUT RIDGE CAPITAL

Ridge Capital is a US land investing company. We buy vacant land directly from owners across the United States and resell it to land buyers and builders. Every offer we make starts with a comp, so this is a core seat on our acquisitions team, not a side task. We are hiring TWO land analysts who will start and train together in November 2026.



THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE

Tell us what a vacant lot is really worth and what could kill the deal, quickly, with comp links to back it up.



EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

- Land comping / land analysis experience is required. You must have hands-on experience valuing US vacant land for a land investor, wholesaler, or similar company.

- Experience working overnight shifts



Applicants without both will not be considered.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're not just filling a seat. We're looking for people who want to build a long-term career with us and grow alongside the business. The right person is:

- Coachable: You welcome feedback, apply it quickly, and keep sharpening your skills.

- Diligent: You take pride in getting the details right, every lot, every time.

- Loyal: You're looking for a long-term home, not a short-term gig, and you treat our business like it's your own.

- Driven to grow: You want more responsibility, and you're ready to earn it as we expand.



If this is you, this role can take you where you want to go. We invest in people who invest in themselves. Your skills will grow with every deal, and your income, title, and responsibilities will grow with them. As Ridge Capital grows, the people who helped build it grow with it. Bring the right attitude, and we'll give you the opportunity to reach your goals here.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Comp vacant land of every type: rural acreage, builder and infill lots, desert parcels

- Pull sold and active comps, work in price per acre, throw out bad comps, and give a value range plus one best number

- Check every lot for deal killers: access / landlocked, flood zone, wetlands, zoning, soils / septic, utilities, slope

- Note the best exit for each lot (retail land buyer, builder, or land-home)

- Work your own lead inbox and prepare offers for manager approval

- Check in with the team every day in Slack



TOOLS

- Land Insights

- LandPortal

- Smarter Contact



HOURS

- Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Pacific Time

- That is 1:00 AM to 9:00 AM Philippine time, Tuesday to Saturday

- Hours may slightly vary. No split shifts.

- This must be your only job during these hours



PAY AND GROWTH

- $700 to $900 USD per month starting base, set by your experience and your work sample results

- PLUS a $100 USD bonus for every deal you comped that closes

- Large opportunity to grow within the business. As our deal volume grows, strong analysts can earn raises and move into bigger roles such as acquisitions lead, deal underwriting, or training and managing new analysts.

- Clear written targets for accuracy and volume, reviewed regularly, so you always know what it takes to move up

- We never charge applicants anything, at any step



WHAT YOU NEED

- Hands-on experience comping US VACANT LAND for a land investor or wholesaler (house-only comping is not enough)

- Clear spoken and written English. You will talk with our US team every day.

- Your own computer, stable internet, and a backup for power and internet (UPS, generator, or a second provider)

- WhatsApp for quick contact

- Care with details. A missed flood zone or landlocked parcel costs real money.



OUR HIRING PROCESS (so you know every step before you apply)

1. Apply here with the code word and a fresh video (see HOW TO APPLY).

2. Qualified applicants get a short message asking for: your expected monthly pay in USD, a speedtest.net result link, your power and internet backup, and your WhatsApp number.

3. 30-minute Google Meet call. Part of it is a live comp: we give you a parcel and you comp it on screen share with your normal tools while you talk us through it.

4. Paid work sample: value 8 vacant lots (market value range and best number, 3 comps with links, red flags, confidence, minutes spent). We pay you $25 USD by Wise for the completed sample. Use your own tools plus free sources. We do not provide logins.

5. We choose two analysts, send written offers, and onboard you in Slack.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word RIDGE. Applications without it are not reviewed.

2. List the land comping tools you use and how many years on each.

3. Tell us roughly how many vacant lots you comp in a normal day, and for what kind of company (land flipper, wholesaler, etc.).

4. Include a link to a NEW 1 to 2 minute Loom video recorded for this job. Start by saying "RIDGE" and today's date, then tell us about your land comping experience. Speak naturally and do not read a script. Old or reused videos are not reviewed.

title: HIRING 4 FULL-TIME B2B APPOINTMENT SETTERS
description:
🚀 HIRING 4 FULL-TIME B2B APPOINTMENT SETTERS



Maverick Creative Group | US Hours (PST) | $7.00 USD/hour | Philippines-Based, Remote



Maverick Creative Group, a US creative and growth agency, is building out its sales team and hiring 4 Appointment Setters to start conversations with US business owners and fill our closers' calendars with qualified calls. If you're confident on the phone, love the chase of a good cold call, and want a structured, compliant, well-trained seat instead of a chaotic call center, read on.



The Role at a Glance

Positions available: 4

• Pay: $7.00 USD per hour, fixed hourly rate

• Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week (8 hours/day) during US Pacific Time (PST) business hours

• Location: Remote (Philippines)

• Platform: Everything runs inside our own CRM and dialer (GoHigh Level). No outside tools needed.

• Start: Fast. Our process takes only a few days from selection to your first shift.



What You'll Do

You are the front door of our sales process. You start the conversation and book it. Our closers take it from there.



1. Fast-response inbound follow-up

Call every inbound Free Growth Audit request within 5 minutes during your shift.

• Qualify the lead, book the audit call onto a closer's calendar, and send the closer a clear written handoff summary.



2. Outbound cold calling to US business owners

Work a scrubbed, compliant call list from Maverick's own numbers using the dialer inside our CRM.

• Open with a clear disclosure, deliver our offer, handle "not interested" once and politely, then book the call or end it cleanly.



3. Qualify every lead on our 5-point check

Only leads that pass reach a closer:

1. Role: Are you speaking with the decision-maker?

2. Budget / Fit: Is Maverick a real fit for their business?

3. Awareness: Do they understand what's being offered?

4. Timing: Are they ready to talk now?

5. Consent: Are they agreeing to the call, with state and time zone confirmed?



4. Keep flawless records

• Log every dial, outcome, and handoff note in the CRM. Nothing about a lead lives outside the CRM.



The Offer You'll Be Pitching

You'll lead every call with one clear, irresistible offer, delivered in our exact approved wording:



Free Business Growth Audit Report + Free 30-Day Social Media Trial (3 short videos & 2 posts per week). A card on file is required to start. After the trial it's $1,000/month, month-to-month. Cancel online anytime before day 31 and pay nothing.



You'll be trained on the full script. You never improvise prices, products, or promises.



Non-Negotiable Rules

This is a compliance-first seat. We protect our clients, our brand, and you. These rules are not optional:

• Setters ONLY book calls. You start the conversation and set the appointment. You NEVER close.

• You NEVER take credit card details. The client enters them on a checkout link sent by the closer.

• You NEVER send cold texts/SMS. No SMS to anyone without a consent record.

• You NEVER quote any price or product detail beyond the approved offer line, and never promise results or guarantees.

• You MUST give the call-recording disclosure at the start of EVERY call.

• Call only between 8 a.m. and 9 p.m. in the prospect's local time, and only from the scrubbed list (Do-Not-Call honored).

• Don't pressure anyone past a second "no."

• If asked, name Maverick's AI team members as AI.



Please note: A compliance breach in your first 30 days means being returned from the program. We take this seriously, and we make the rules simple to follow.



Training & Growth

• Day-1 orientation (2 hours): compliance, the offer, the CRM, and the scripts.

• Daily practice with "Reese" (our AI sales trainer) in the Agent Drill Room™ to keep your objection handling sharp. You'll pass role-plays and get signed off by a person before your first live dial.

• First-week call review: our team reviews your recorded calls and gives you direct feedback.

• Scripts provided: you'll read from the script until your first weekly review.

• Ongoing reviews at 30 and 90 days.



Who We're Looking For

Must-haves:

• Proven outbound cold-calling experience with US customers (setting, lead gen, telesales, or similar). Be ready to share your dial, connect, and booking numbers.

• Clear, confident, natural spoken English with a friendly, professional tone.

• Ability to work a full US Pacific Time schedule reliably.

• A stable internet connection, quality headset, and quiet workspace with a reliable computer.

• Strong discipline with scripts, compliance, and detailed note-taking.

• Resilience. You hear "no" often and bounce back with energy.



Nice-to-haves:

• Experience with GoHigh Level or other CRMs

• Experience selling marketing or agency services to small business owners



MANDATORY APPLICATION STEP: VOICE/VIDEO AUDITION

READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY. Every applicant MUST submit a 30-to-60-second audio or video recording link introducing yourself and reading the sample script below. Applications without a voice recording will be automatically disqualified. No exceptions. Résumés alone will not be reviewed.



Accepted formats: Loom, Vocaroo, or a Google Drive link (set to "Anyone with the link can view").



Your recording must include:

1. A short introduction: your name and your calling experience (1-2 sentences).

2. The sample script below, read naturally. Don't sound robotic.



Sample script (read aloud):

"Hi, this is [Your Name] calling from Maverick Creative Group. Quick heads-up, this call is recorded. Am I speaking with the owner?... Great. The reason I'm calling is that we're offering local business owners a free growth audit report, plus a free 30-day trial of our social media package. Is it okay if I take thirty seconds to tell you how it works?"



We're listening for a clear voice, a warm tone, natural pacing, and confident delivery.



How to Apply

Send your application with the following, in this order:

1. Subject line: Setter Application [Your Full Name]

2. Your audition link (Loom / Vocaroo / Google Drive)

3. A short summary of your cold-calling experience: companies, markets (US?), and your best dial/connect/booking numbers

4. Your current internet speed and a description of your headset/setup

5. Confirmation that you can work 8 hours/day, 40 hours/week on US Pacific Time business hours



Our process: Application with audition → short recorded 15-minute live role-play → selection → Day-1 orientation → Reese sign-off → you're on the phones.



If you're a driven caller who wants to start real conversations with US business owners, we want to hear your voice.



Apply today.

title: Shopify E-commerce Launch & Growth Specialist — Faith-Based POD Brand
description:

**Part-Time | Remote (Philippines) | $8–12 USD/Hour**

We're looking for a **resourceful, commercially minded Shopify specialist** who can help us attract customers, generate sales, and build a sustainable online business.



We have a growing product catalog, a small team, and a clear mission. What we need is someone who knows how to turn a promising store into a business that actually sells.



This is not a typical virtual assistant or store administration role. We're looking for someone who takes initiative, makes sound decisions, and enjoys building something from the ground up.



### What You'll Do



- **Acquire customers:** Develop and execute practical experiments to attract our first customers and generate sales with a limited marketing budget.

- **Improve conversion:** Optimize Shopify merchandising, product discovery, product pages, and the customer journey.

- **Build marketing systems:** Improve
 marketing, customer acquisition, retention, and performance tracking.

- **Apply e-commerce economics:** Understand product pricing, POD margins, shipping costs, and customer acquisition costs.

- **Collaborate with our team:** Work alongside existing POD operations and content specialists to align product launches, marketing, and growth initiatives.

- **Take ownership:** Identify the highest-value priorities, execute independently, measure results, and recommend improvements.

- **Work efficiently:** Use AI and automation tools where they meaningfully improve execution.



### What We're Looking For



**Essential**

- Hands-on Shopify experience, preferably launching or growing a small DTC brand.

- Practical experience acquiring customers or improving e-commerce sales, with examples of what you personally accomplished.

- Understanding of merchandising, conversion optimization, and marketing fundamentals.

- Familiarity with print-on-demand business models and their economics.

- Strong initiative, problem-solving ability, and independent judgment.

- Excellent written English and remote collaboration skills.

- Genuine appreciation for our Christian mission and values.



**Bonus:** Printify or Printful, Meta Ads, SEO,
 marketing, Shopify Flow, and AI automation.



We value demonstrated results and good judgment more than a long list of software skills.



### Compensation & Opportunity



- $8–12 USD/hour, depending on experience.

- Approximately 10 hours/week initially, with flexible scheduling.

- Paid trial project for shortlisted candidates.

- Opportunity to grow responsibilities and hours as the business develops.

- Direct collaboration with the founder and a small, mission-driven team.



### How to Apply



Please answer these three questions with specific examples rather than general advice.



**1. Customer Acquisition**



Tell us about an e-commerce business where you personally helped attract customers or increase sales. What did you do, what was the budget, and what results did you achieve? Approximate or anonymized figures are fine.



**2. Shopify & POD Experience**



Describe your hands-on Shopify experience and any experience with print-on-demand. What have you personally built, improved, or launched?



**3. Launch Challenge**



Imagine you're joining a faith-based Shopify brand with a growing catalog, almost no sales, and a limited marketing budget.



**You have 10 hours per week. What is the ONE customer-acquisition experiment you would run first?**



Explain who you would target, how you would reach them, what you would test, and how you'd measure success.



Please also include your expected hourly rate, weekly availability, and a brief note about why working with a Christian mission-driven brand interests you.



**Application subject:** Shopify Growth — Faith-Based Brand



We're looking for someone who thinks like an owner, executes without constant supervision, and wants to help build something meaningful from the beginning.

title: Electrical CAD Drafter / Designer
