We’re Hiring: Electrical CAD Drafter / Designer

Full-Time | Remote | California Operations



RRE Inc. is a relationship-based electrical contractor in Northern California looking for an experienced Electrical CAD Drafter / Designer with strong AutoCAD skills and practical electrical knowledge.



You will help us generate electrical drawings for projects we design and build, coordinate with our Superintendent and Estimating Team, and develop an RRE Electrical Drawing Standards Book of approved details and templates.



We build strong relationships with our clients, partners, and team members through trust, accountability, and consistent follow-through. We ask questions, pick up the phone, and work through details together.



Our Mission



Team RRE’s mission is to provide maximum value to our team members and clients while creating a safe, great environment where our team members can grow, win, and have great careers.



Our Vision



We are in the process of being the greatest electrical contracting team, with 5,000 team members in the right seats, led by our culture and standards.



Our Core Values



Our core values are simple and non-negotiable:



- We are team players.

- We prioritize open communication.

- We exercise emotional control.

- We do the right thing.

- We are dedicated to winning.



These values are Team RRE’s DNA. They guide how we work, communicate, hire, and coach. Every team member shares responsibility for protecting and strengthening our culture.



Responsibilities



1. Create and revise electrical drawings using **AutoCAD 2D and 3D**, including power and lighting layouts, conduit routing, equipment connections, and installation details.

2. Review electrical plans, architectural backgrounds, specifications, and field markups.

3. Coordinate with Superintendents, Foremen, and the Estimating Team to ensure drawings support installation and estimating.

4. Develop reusable drawing templates, symbols, and approved details for the **RRE Electrical Drawing Standards Book**.

5. Complete **2–3 defined drawing deliverables per week**, based on agreed scope and complexity.

6. Incorporate review comments, maintain drawing revisions, and prepare record drawings from verified field changes.



Qualifications



1. At least two years of electrical construction drafting experience, with a portfolio of relevant work.

2. Strong AutoCAD 2D and 3D skills, including layers, blocks, external references, layouts, dimensions, and plotting.

3. Practical understanding of electrical systems, materials, and installation methods.

4. Ability to read electrical plans, single-line diagrams, specifications, and technical markups.

5. Basic familiarity with the National Electrical Code, with willingness to learn California and local requirements.

6. Strong communication, organization, attention to detail, and ability to meet deadlines.



Experience supporting US electrical contractors, creating standard details, or using Bluebeam, Revit, BIM, and AI tools to improve productivity is a plus.



**Note:** This position supports our California operations, so you must be comfortable working overnight Philippine time.



If you enjoy electrical drafting, creating practical standards, and building strong working relationships with a team committed to growth and winning, we’d love to hear from you.



Please submit your resume and samples of your electrical CAD work.

title: Probate Litigation Paralegal
description:
We only review applications from candidates who meet all of the qualifications listed below.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application to 
 with the subject line "Probate Litigation Paralegal Application: [Your Name]" and include:



1. Resume highlighting your legal background and CALIFORNIA probate litigation experience

2. Cover letter describing your probate and probate litigation experience as it relates to this role

3. Expected hourly rate or salary range

4. Available start date



ABOUT BAY LEGAL, PC



Bay Legal, PC is a full-service California law firm combining expert legal counsel with modern technology to deliver seamless, results-driven representation.



POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Probate Litigation Paralegal / Legal Assistant with direct experience in a California law firm. This role focuses on contested probate, trust, and estate matters, and we are specifically looking for candidates who have supported attorneys through the full life of a probate litigation case, from the initial petition through discovery, hearings, mediation, and settlement or trial. The ideal candidate holds a law degree, is a currently practicing attorney, or brings extensive hands-on paralegal experience in California probate litigation.



PROBATE LITIGATION EXPERIENCE (REQUIRED)



California probate litigation experience is required. Experience with probate matters in other states is a plus and will be considered alongside it. Relevant experience includes:



- Will and trust contests

- Petitions under Probate Code Section 850 (including Heggstad petitions) and petitions for instructions

- Petitions to remove or suspend trustees, executors, or administrators

- Breach of fiduciary duty and trust accounting disputes, including objections to accountings

- Financial elder abuse claims connected to estates or trusts

- Contested conservatorships and guardianships

- Creditor claims, spousal and domestic partner property petitions, and heirship disputes



We also value experience with uncontested probate administration, including petitions for probate, Letters, Notices of Proposed Action, inventories and appraisals with the probate referee, creditor notices, and petitions for final distribution.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Law degree (JD or foreign law degree) OR currently practicing attorney OR minimum 4 years of substantive paralegal experience in a California law firm

- Minimum 4 years of probate or probate litigation experience within a California law firm

- Working knowledge of the California Probate Code, California Rules of Court, and local probate rules

- Experience preparing and filing Judicial Council probate forms and California court e-filing

- Hands-on experience with Lawmatics and Clio Manage

- Paralegal certificate from an ABA-approved program preferred

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple cases and deadlines at the same time

- Reliable internet connection and home office setup for remote work



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Draft first-pass probate petitions, objections, responses, declarations, and proposed orders from firm templates for attorney review.

- Prepare and file Judicial Council probate forms, notices of hearing, and proofs of service with California superior courts.

- Monitor probate notes and tentative rulings, and help clear defects before hearing dates.

- Track and calendar statutory and court deadlines, including trust contest periods, hearing dates, continuances, and discovery deadlines.

- Prepare discovery requests and responses, deposition notices, and subpoenas for records, and organize documents received.

- Gather and organize evidence such as bank records, estate planning documents, medical records, and asset information for attorneys.

- Prepare and review fiduciary accountings and supporting schedules, and flag discrepancies for attorney review.

- Assist with mediation and settlement preparation, including briefs, exhibits, and settlement agreements.

- Assist with trial preparation, including exhibit lists, witness lists, and trial binders.

- Conduct factual research on estate assets, property records, court dockets, and public records, subject to attorney review.

- Conduct client intake interviews and gather case information under attorney supervision.

- Communicate professionally with clients, beneficiaries, heirs, courts, probate examiners, court investigators, and opposing counsel.

- Manage and update case files, deadlines, and client records in practice management systems (Lawmatics, Clio Manage, etc.).

- Coordinate execution, notarization, and e-signatures on legal documents.

- Draft, review, and proofread legal documents and correspondence, keep accurate records of all case activities, and maintain contemporaneous time records.

title: Orthodontic Scheduling Virtual Assistant
description:
Orthodontic Virtual Assistant |Full-Time| Remote| $7-$8 USD/hour| 



Our best days at the pratice start with good music playing low and a phone that keeps ringing in the best way. Every caller

hears someone who sounds genuinely glad they called. By the end of the day, people who dialed in unsure have

a first visit on the calendar and are already looking forward to it. Nobody is rushing. Nobody sounds like they're

reading a script. Dr. B and the team are in sync, and the day moves like a great set: everyone knows their part,

and the whole room sounds better because of it. You'll be working virtually, but you are still part of that room.



We are small by choice. That means you will know our patients and families by name, they will know your voice,

and the people you work with will notice when you do something great and say so out loud. We're a brand new

practice in Green Hills, Nashville, and you will be one of the very first voices people hear. We're building

something we are really proud of, one great phone call at a time!



Everything we do runs on five values we call MAGIC: Mastery, Authenticity, Growth, Integrity, and Compassion.

They aren't a poster on the wall. They're how we show up for our patients and for each other, and they're what

we look for in every person who joins us.



Who thrives here



You're someone who lives our five values without being told, and who lights up when the phone rings:



Mastery. You take pride in a clean, well run schedule and a perfectly confirmed appointment, and you would

rather ask "why do we do it this way?" than guess. New software and a really good system give you a little

thrill, and insurance language sounds like something you'd enjoy learning, not something to fear.



Authenticity. You're the same warm, upbeat person on a call as you are with your best friend. Your energy

is natural, not performed. You can make a worried parent and a shy teenager both feel like the most

interesting caller of the day, and you tell the truth kindly, whether that's "that time is taken, but here's a great

option" or "here's what I'd do differently."



Growth. You're curious, you welcome change, and you hear "small team" and think "my ideas will be

heard," not "that sounds like a lot."



Integrity. You do the right thing when no one is watching. When you promise a callback, you call back. You

show up on time and ready because the first caller of the day is counting on you, and when you make a

mistake you say so and fix it.



Compassion. You can hear the worry in someone's voice and slow down before anyone asks you to. You

listen first, because every patient and family calls with different needs and different questions.



Your phone presence is the job. A caller meets us through your voice, and a warm, upbeat, confident

one is the best first impression we could ask for. If you light up on a call, we want to meet you.



Requirements

Dental scheduling experience is required, and orthodontic scheduling experience is a bonus. 



Insurance experience is not required, because we will train you. Energy and heart are the things we can't teach, and everything else we can. If you have both, we want to hear from you!





What you'll do



This role is more than scheduling. Here is what your days cover, and we will train you on the insurance side.



Patient Communication

Make outbound calls to patients as needed

Communicate professionally with patients and families

Follow scripts and practice protocols while sounding natural

Escalate questions or concerns to the appropriate team member

Maintain a positive, patient first tone on all calls



Observation and Follow Up Scheduling

Contact patients who need to schedule follow up appointments

Support observation recall and pending appointment follow up

Speak with patients in a warm, professional, and helpful way

Help patients understand next steps and get scheduled

Document call outcomes and follow up needs accurately



Insurance Verification

Verify dental and orthodontic insurance eligibility and benefits

Confirm coverage, deductibles, maximums, waiting periods, and limitations

Complete accurate insurance breakdowns

Document insurance details clearly in the practice management system

Flag missing, unclear, or incorrect insurance information for follow up



Claims Follow Up

Follow up on unpaid, denied, rejected, or delayed claims

Contact insurance companies as needed to check claim status

Review EOBs and identify payment discrepancies

Document claim updates clearly for the team

Help keep insurance and billing workflows moving accurately



What a star looks like at six months



Here are the three things on your scorecard. Hit these and you're not just doing the job, you're the reason our

days feel the way they do.



1. Every call feels like the best call of the patient's day. Phones are answered quickly and warmly, new

patient inquiries turn into booked first visits, and callers feel heard before they hang up. Families mention

your voice by name, and so do our reviews.



2. The schedule is full, smooth, and honest. Appointments are confirmed, reschedules are handled with a

smile, and missed visits get a friendly follow up. Dr. B's day flows without gaps or chaos, and the team never

wonders what's coming next.



3. You've grown into the insurance side and made us better. After our training, you can explain the basics

of orthodontic benefits to a family in plain words and know exactly when to bring in a teammate. You've also

brought us at least one idea that improved how we answer calls or run the schedule, and we put it in place.





Schedule: 7:30am -4:30pm Central Time, with a one-hour unpaid lunch



The phone is the job. Much of your day is spent on the phone with patients and insurance companies, both

answering calls and making them. This is not a quiet, heads down,
 only seat. If you would rather avoid

the phone, this isn't the one for you.



Your voice has to come through clearly. You'll need clear, natural, confident spoken English, a quiet

space to work, reliable high speed internet, and a good headset.



We will train you on insurance. You don't need to know it already. You do need to be willing to learn it.



We're new. Some systems are still being built. Some days will be packed and some will be quiet, and

everyone pitches in on whatever needs doing, including the unglamorous stuff.

You'll hear the truth. We'll tell you what's working and what isn't, and we expect the same back.





How to apply



Please submit the following:

1. A viewable link to your updated resume

2. A short paragraph describing your experience with:

a. Dental or orthodontic insurance verification

b. Patient scheduling or phone communication

3. A list of any dental, orthodontic, billing, or phone systems you have used

4. A short voice or video introduction via Vocaroo, Loom, or a similar platform so we can evaluate phone

readiness and communication style



Subject line: Orthodontic VA: Insurance & Scheduling | [Your Full Name]



We can't wait to hear from you!

title: Healthcare Administrative Virtual Assistant |Behavioral Health | Client Care | Billing | Social Media & Operations
description:
# Healthcare Administrative Virtual Assistant

**Behavioral Health | Client Care | Billing | Social Media & Operations**



**Part-Time | 20–25 Hours per Week | Remote | U.S. Behavioral Health Practice**



### About NEW Counseling



Nashville Emotional Wellness (NEW) Counseling is a growing U.S.-based behavioral health group practice committed to providing accessible, culturally responsive mental health services.



We are seeking an **experienced, versatile Healthcare Administrative Virtual Assistant** who can independently support multiple areas of our practice, including patient coordination, administrative operations, billing support, social media, and business development.



This is an excellent opportunity for a healthcare administrative professional who enjoys variety, takes initiative, and wants to grow with an expanding mental health organization.



### Position Overview



This is a **hands-on, cross-functional administrative position** for someone who already understands U.S. healthcare workflows and can quickly adapt to a behavioral health practice.



You will help manage the daily administrative activities that keep our practice organized, responsive, and operating efficiently.



The ideal candidate has direct experience supporting a U.S. medical, mental health, psychiatric, or therapy practice and is comfortable working across several business functions.



**We are particularly interested in candidates who are proactive, organized, technologically proficient, resourceful, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.**



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Client Care Coordination & Intake**

- Respond to prospective client inquiries professionally and promptly.

- Coordinate new-client intake, scheduling, and appointment follow-up.

- Maintain accurate client information in electronic health record systems.

- Support insurance eligibility and benefits verification.

- Coordinate administrative communications among clients, clinicians, and leadership.

- Track outstanding client requests and ensure timely follow-through.



**2. Billing & Revenue Cycle Support**

- Assist with insurance verification, authorizations, and billing-related administrative tasks.

- Support claims tracking, payment follow-up, and accounts receivable monitoring.

- Identify billing discrepancies and route complex issues appropriately.

- Maintain organized financial and billing records.

- Coordinate with the billing team to resolve outstanding administrative issues.



**3. Administrative Operations & Systems**

- Manage administrative
, calendars, documentation, and task follow-up.

- Maintain organized digital records, trackers, and operational dashboards.

- Follow and improve standard operating procedures (SOPs).

- Support workflow coordination, reporting, and administrative projects.

- Use Google Workspace, practice management systems, and AI-supported tools to improve efficiency.



**4. Social Media, Marketing & Outreach**

- Schedule and publish approved content across social media platforms.

- Assist with Canva graphics, newsletters, and basic content formatting.

- Maintain content calendars and coordinate promotional activities.

- Support referral outreach, partnership communications, and community engagement.

- Track marketing activities, engagement, and outreach follow-up.



**5. Clinical & Business Coordination**

- Support administrative coordination for clinicians and practice programs.

- Assist with documentation tracking, scheduling, and internal communication.

- Coordinate special projects and practice development initiatives.

- Help maintain efficient communication across departments.



### Required Qualifications



- **At least 2 years of direct U.S. healthcare administration experience**, preferably supporting a medical, behavioral health, psychiatric, or therapy practice.

- Experience with patient intake, scheduling, insurance verification, billing support, or related healthcare workflows.

- Familiarity with electronic health records (EHR/EMR) or practice management software.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities independently.

- Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and follow-through.

- Experience using Google Workspace and other digital administrative tools.

- Understanding of HIPAA and patient confidentiality requirements.

- Ability to work scheduled hours that overlap with U.S. Central Time.



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working with **SimplePractice** or comparable behavioral health EHR systems.

- Direct experience supporting a mental health group practice.

- Experience with insurance claims, accounts receivable, prior authorizations, or revenue cycle management.

- Experience managing social media accounts, Canva, or content scheduling tools.

- Familiarity with CRM platforms, project management tools, and AI-assisted workflows.

- Experience supporting multiple providers or departments.

- Experience developing or improving administrative SOPs.



Who Will Succeed in This Role



We are looking for someone who:



- Has already worked in U.S. healthcare administration and does not require extensive foundational training.

- Takes ownership of assigned tasks and follows through without repeated reminders.

- Knows when to independently solve a problem and when to escalate.

- Is comfortable learning new systems through written instructions and existing documentation.

- Can move between client care, billing, operations, and marketing tasks as priorities change.

- Communicates clearly, identifies problems early, and maintains accurate records.

- Is comfortable working in an evolving organization where responsibilities may expand over time.



Schedule & Opportunity



- **20–25 hours per week initially**, with potential for increased hours as practice needs evolve.

- Remote position supporting a U.S.-based behavioral health practice.

- Some scheduled overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours required.

- Opportunity for long-term collaboration and expanded responsibilities.



### How to Apply



Please submit your résumé and answer the following questions:



1. How many years have you worked directly in U.S. healthcare administration? What type of practice did you support?

2. Which EHR/EMR or practice management systems have you used?

3. Describe your hands-on experience with patient intake, scheduling, insurance verification, and billing support. Which tasks did you personally perform?

4. Have you supported a mental health, psychiatric, or therapy practice? If so, describe your responsibilities.

5. What experience do you have with Canva, social media scheduling, marketing, or outreach?

6. Describe a situation where you independently identified and resolved an administrative problem.

7. What is your desired hourly rate, weekly availability, and availability during U.S. Central Time business hours?



**Please provide specific examples of your healthcare experience. Applicants with direct U.S. healthcare administration experience will receive priority consideration.**

title: Underwriting & Merchant Onboarding Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced **Underwriting & Merchant Onboarding Manager** with a strong background in merchant services, payment processing, risk management, and merchant account approvals.



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience underwriting merchant accounts, managing onboarding operations, evaluating merchant risk, and working with payment processors, acquiring banks, and payment gateways.



**Experience working with telemedicine, telehealth, or other high-risk merchant verticals is a significant plus.**



This role requires someone who understands the merchant services industry, can make sound underwriting decisions, streamline onboarding processes, and ensure merchants are approved and activated efficiently while maintaining strong compliance and risk standards.



### Key Responsibilities



**Merchant Underwriting & Risk Management**

- Oversee the review, evaluation, and approval of merchant account applications.

- Analyze merchant financials, business models, processing history, chargebacks, and potential risk exposure.

- Conduct merchant due diligence, including KYC, KYB, OFAC screening, and other applicable compliance checks.

- Identify potential fraud, regulatory concerns, and high-risk merchant activity.

- Work directly with acquiring banks, processors, and risk teams to facilitate merchant approvals.

- Establish and maintain underwriting policies, procedures, and approval guidelines.

- Review and assess higher-risk merchants, including telemedicine and healthcare-related businesses.



**Merchant Onboarding & Operations**

- Manage the end-to-end merchant onboarding process, from application submission through account activation.

- Ensure applications are processed accurately, efficiently, and within established timelines.

- Coordinate with sales, compliance, risk, and technical integration teams.

- Resolve onboarding delays, documentation issues, and processor-related challenges.

- Develop and improve onboarding workflows to increase approval efficiency and reduce turnaround times.

- Oversee merchant account setup, documentation verification, and processor submissions.

- Maintain strong relationships with processing partners and acquiring banks.



**Team Leadership & Process Improvement**

- Lead, train, and support underwriting and onboarding team members.

- Establish performance standards and monitor key operational metrics.

- Identify opportunities to automate and streamline underwriting and onboarding processes.

- Maintain compliance with payment industry regulations, card network rules, and internal policies.

- Provide management with reporting on merchant approval rates, onboarding timelines, risk trends, and operational performance.



### Required Qualifications



- **5+ years of experience in merchant services, payment processing, merchant underwriting, or risk management.**

- Previous management or team leadership experience in underwriting, onboarding, or merchant operations.

- Strong understanding of merchant account underwriting and approval processes.

- Experience working with acquiring banks, payment processors, ISOs, payment facilitators, or merchant service providers.

- Knowledge of KYC, KYB, AML, OFAC, PCI DSS, and applicable card network requirements.

- Experience reviewing merchant financials, processing statements, chargeback ratios, and business models.

- Familiarity with high-risk merchant underwriting and risk mitigation.

- Excellent organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to manage multiple merchant applications while maintaining efficiency and attention to detail.



### Preferred Qualifications — Strong Plus



- **Experience in the telemedicine or telehealth industry.**

- Experience underwriting telemedicine, online healthcare, or other regulated healthcare-related merchant accounts.

- Understanding of payment processing challenges associated with telehealth businesses, recurring billing, and card-not-present transactions.

- Established working relationships with acquiring banks, processors, and underwriting departments.

- Experience developing underwriting and onboarding procedures for growing merchant services organizations.

- Familiarity with high-risk payment processing, reserves, rolling reserves, and chargeback management.



### What We're Looking For



We want a proactive, detail-oriented professional who understands how merchant services operates beyond basic application processing.



The successful candidate should be comfortable working directly with processors and banks, handling complex underwriting scenarios, managing merchant approvals, and building scalable onboarding operations.



**Candidates with merchant services experience who also understand the telemedicine payment processing space will be highly preferred.**



### Compensation



Competitive salary based on experience, with compensation and benefits discussed during the interview process.



### How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with a brief overview of your experience in merchant underwriting, merchant onboarding, payment processing, and any relevant telemedicine or high-risk merchant verticals.

title: Brand & Creative Lead / Senior Graphic Designer - Ecommerce
description:
BRAND & CREATIVE LEAD / SENIOR GRAPHIC DESIGNER — ECOMMERCE



Full-time | Remote, Philippines | US$1,700–$1,950/month



ABOUT US



Bathify and Haum are North American ecommerce brands in the bath, kitchen, furniture, and home categories.



Bathify combines design-forward bathroom and kitchen products with accessible value. Haum takes a more curated, editorial approach to furniture and home design.



We’re looking for an exceptional hands-on designer who can take ownership of how both brands look and communicate across our websites and marketing channels.



THE OPPORTUNITY



You will develop campaign concepts, plan upcoming creative work, produce polished graphics, and give our social and paid-media teams clear creative direction.



You should be comfortable turning a business objective into a strong visual concept and carrying it through to finished assets, with thoughtful recommendations along the way.



You should understand how established home and lifestyle brands create a cohesive customer experience across websites, seasonal campaigns, and marketing channels. Your role is to bring that level of polish and consistency to Bathify and Haum while strengthening each brand’s distinct identity.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



• Brand consistency: Maintain and improve each brand’s visual guidelines, templates, typography, colour use, imagery, and layout standards.



• Campaign planning: Build and maintain a rolling creative calendar covering seasonal edits, promotions, product launches, and key retail moments. Recommend concepts and prepare assets ahead of deadlines.



• Website creative: Design homepage heroes, desktop and mobile banners, collection graphics, promotional tiles, and other ecommerce assets.



• Seasonal storytelling: Develop themes, product stories, image selections, and supporting headlines that give customers a compelling reason to explore.



• Paid-media support: Work with our paid-media team to translate campaign objectives and performance feedback into creative concepts, finished graphics, and test variations.



• Social direction: Provide our social team with campaign themes, visual references, templates, and feedback that keep content consistent with each brand.



• Creative coordination: Organize briefs, priorities, approvals, source files, and final exports. Flag missing inputs early and keep stakeholders informed.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



• An outstanding portfolio demonstrating strong typography, composition, colour judgement, image selection, and attention to detail.



• Typically 4+ years of relevant design experience, with evidence of independently owning campaigns or a brand’s ongoing creative output.



• Experience designing for ecommerce or consumer brands, ideally in home, interiors, furniture, lifestyle, fashion, or a related category.



• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, plus comfort with Figma or a comparable layout and collaboration tool.



• Experience adapting campaigns across desktop, mobile, paid social, and organic social formats.



• Strong written English and the ability to develop clear headlines and short promotional copy.



• Initiative: You can propose concepts, explain your decisions, identify gaps, and move work forward without needing every step prescribed.



• Strong organization and the ability to manage agreed priorities across two distinct brands.



• Willingness to use feedback and performance results to improve the work.



ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS



• Motion graphics, animated banners, GIFs, or short-form video editing.

• Art direction for product and lifestyle photography.

• Familiarity with Shopify creative requirements.

• Experience collaborating with external marketing agencies.

• Responsible use of AI tools to support ideation and production, with careful quality control.



HOW WE WILL WORK



You will work directly with the founder and collaborate with our existing marketing partners.



You will own creative planning and execution. Commercial goals, promotional offers, and marketing budgets will be agreed with the founder and relevant teams.



This is a 40-hour-per-week role, Monday to Friday. Our proposed schedule includes two hours of overlap with Toronto business hours, ideally 9–11 a.m. Toronto time, with the remaining hours flexible. Please confirm whether this works for you.



Priorities and production capacity will be agreed together so that deadlines and quality expectations are clear.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Within your first 90 days:



• Both brands have clear, distinct visual direction and practical design standards.

• A rolling creative calendar is in place, with upcoming work planned in advance.

• Campaign assets feel consistent across website, social, and paid-media placements.

• Files, templates, and approvals are organized.

• You regularly bring forward ideas and deliver agreed work with decreasing need for detailed direction.



HOW TO APPLY



Please use the subject line:

Brand & Creative Lead — [Your Name]



Include:



1. Your portfolio link and three projects most relevant to this role. For each, briefly explain what you personally created or led.



2. One example of a campaign you developed from initial concept through final delivery across multiple formats.



3. A short example of a time you identified a creative need and took the initiative to address it.



4. Your resume or LinkedIn profile.



5. Your expected monthly compensation in USD, earliest start date, and availability for the proposed Toronto overlap.



Relevant portfolio work is required. We will assess design quality, ownership, communication, and organization.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a paid practical exercise followed by a discussion of their work.

title: 3PL Billing, Bookkeeping & Back Office Coordinator – Remote (Philippines)
description:
About ALS West Coast Logistics



ALS West Coast Logistics is a U.S.-based third-party logistics (3PL) and warehousing company located in Commerce, California. We provide warehousing, receiving, shipping, inventory handling, and fulfillment services for our customers.



We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented remote coordinator to support our daily billing, bookkeeping, and administrative operations.



This person will play an important role in keeping our paperwork organized, ensuring warehouse activity is properly billed, processing customer invoices, and assisting with accounts payable and receivable.



Key Responsibilities



1. BOL Processing & Documentation



Receive approximately 50–100 Bills of Lading (BOLs) per week.



Review, organize, and file BOLs by customer, date, container, and shipment.



Match BOLs against completed warehouse transactions.



Maintain an accurate daily BOL tracking report.



Identify missing paperwork and follow up with the appropriate team members.



Keep digital customer and shipment folders organized.



2. Customer Billing & Invoicing



Prepare and process approximately 10–25 customer invoices per week using QuickBooks Online.



Verify completed warehouse services against BOLs and transaction records.



Apply customer-specific rate sheets and billing requirements.



Verify accessorial charges such as pallets, labeling, documentation, and additional warehouse services.



Ensure completed work is invoiced accurately and on time.



Maintain an open billing report to identify completed work that has not yet been invoiced.



3. Accounts Payable & Vendor Billing



Receive and organize trucking company and vendor invoices.



Match trucking bills against BOLs and supporting documentation.



Verify charges against agreed rates and flag discrepancies.



Enter approved vendor bills into QuickBooks Online.



Track due dates and maintain organized vendor records.



Identify duplicate invoices or billing discrepancies.



4. Accounts Receivable



Monitor customer payments and outstanding invoices.



Apply customer payments in QuickBooks Online.



Maintain accounts receivable aging reports.



Follow up on overdue invoices.



Report past-due balances and payment issues to management.



5. Bookkeeping & Administrative Support



Assist with categorizing expenses and financial transactions.



Help organize receipts and supporting financial documents.



Assist with bank and credit card reconciliations.



Prepare weekly billing and accounts payable reports.



Assist with month-end bookkeeping and reporting.



Coordinate with our U.S. accounting team or CPA when needed.



Required Qualifications



At least 2–3 years of experience in U.S. bookkeeping, billing, or accounting support.



Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online.



Experience with accounts payable and accounts receivable.



Experience preparing customer invoices and processing vendor bills.



Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.



Excellent written and verbal English communication.



Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.



Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.



Comfortable working U.S. business hours.



Preferred Qualifications



Previous experience working for a U.S. 3PL, warehouse, freight, or logistics company.



Experience processing Bills of Lading (BOLs).



Experience reviewing trucking and freight invoices.



Familiarity with warehouse billing, storage charges, and accessorial fees.



Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS), preferably Extensiv or 3PL Central.



What We Are Looking For



We want someone dependable, organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of daily responsibilities.



The ideal candidate will not simply enter information into QuickBooks. They should be able to review documents, identify discrepancies, recognize missing billing, and communicate problems before they become bigger issues.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position who can grow with our company.



Please include the following when applying:



Describe your experience with QuickBooks Online.



Have you worked with a U.S. warehouse, 3PL, trucking, or logistics company?



Have you processed BOLs or freight invoices?



What types of accounts payable and accounts receivable tasks have you handled?



What is your experience working with U.S. customers or companies?



Are you available to work California business hours?

Entry Level Details

Qualifications

What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experience lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINK ELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

title: Credit Dispute Specialist
description:
We’re Hiring: Credit Dispute Specialist



Are you experienced in credit repair, detail-oriented, and confident in communicating with clients? New Gen Solutions LLC is looking for a Credit Dispute Specialist to review credit reports, process disputes, monitor case progress, and assist clients throughout the credit dispute process.



We’re seeking a dependable and proactive individual with a solid understanding of credit reporting, strong organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple client accounts while ensuring accurate documentation and excellent customer service.



Key Responsibilities



Review credit reports and identify inaccurate, outdated, or unverifiable information.



Prepare, submit, and track disputes with the three major credit bureaus: Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion.



File complaints with the CFPB, BBB, ATG, and FTC when appropriate.



Monitor dispute deadlines, analyze responses, and determine the necessary follow-up actions.



Provide clients with timely updates regarding their dispute status and progress.



Maintain accurate client records, dispute histories, and supporting documentation.



Manage and update client information using GoHighLevel and/or Credit Repair Cloud (CRC).



Assist with additional administrative duties related to credit dispute operations.



Qualifications and Requirements



1–2 years of hands-on experience in credit repair or credit dispute processing.



Strong understanding of credit reporting practices, FCRA, and FDCPA.



Familiarity with credit bureaus and regulatory agencies is a plus.



Experience in client outreach or appointment setting is an advantage.



Excellent verbal and written communication skills.



Confidence in handling phone conversations and communicating professionally with clients.



Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple accounts efficiently.



Excellent organizational skills, time management, and follow-through.



Self-motivated, dependable, and able to work independently.



Experience with CRM platforms; GoHighLevel is preferred.



How to Apply



Interested applicants must submit the following:



CV/Resume Link – Provide a link to your updated CV or resume.



1-Minute Video Introduction – Introduce yourself and briefly discuss your relevant experience and qualifications.



Family Birth Order – Indicate whether you are the Eldest, Middle, or Youngest child.



Required
 Subject Format:



Credit Dispute Specialist – [Your Name]_[Birth Order]



Important: Applications must include all the required information and follow the specified submission format. Incomplete applications or submissions that do not follow the instructions will not be reviewed.



If you have the experience, attention to detail, and commitment to helping clients address credit reporting issues, we encourage you to apply and join the New Gen Solutions LLC team!
